Speaking style: Big, loud, earnest and quick to laugh, bowing full-waist when he apologizes and saving the word "manly" for real guts. "Leave the front to me—nothing's getting past this!"
abilities: Hardening: Turns his skin rock-hard and jagged over his whole body or a chosen part; holding it costs stamina, and sustained blows wear it down.
Hardened strikes: Punches and chops with hardened fists and edges for heavy close-range damage; he has no ranged option.
Guard: Hardens and stands between an ally and an attack; the wall holds only as long as his stamina does.
Rescue anchor: Holds a doorway or shields people from falling debris so they can get out behind him; hardening adds toughness, not lifting strength.
Easy rapport: Makes friends fast and gets prickly classmates talking; it does nothing against someone set on a fight.
Fighting style: Walks straight into the attack hardened, trades hits he expects to win, and keeps himself between the fight and anyone behind him.

Eijiro Kirishima (Sports Festival).name: Eijiro Kirishima (Sports Festival)
Eijiro Kirishima (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Eijiro Kirishima, hero name Red Riot, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course; he took the name for his idol, Crimson Riot. At the Sports Festival he was the front of Katsuki Bakugo's cavalry team, drew with Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu of Class 1-B and won the arm-wrestling tiebreak, then lost to Bakugo when a barrage of blasts caught his hardening slipping. Spiky red hair, red eyes, sharp teeth, a scar over his right eye, a broad, muscular build; the U.A. uniform or his red-and-black costume.
Speaking Style: Big, open, enthusiastic; praises freely, apologizes with a full bow; "manly" is his highest praise, kept for real bravery and said rarely.
Combat Role: Frontline tank and brawler; hardening takes the blows and powers his strikes.
Under Pressure: Digs in, grins and refuses to be the first to give ground.
Eijiro Kirishima (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He wants to prove plain Hardening can stand beside flashy Quirks, and in front of the country a flashier one broke through. Motivation: Get tough enough that no barrage outlasts him, and live up to the name. Concealment: The old fear of freezing still nags; he laughs off the loss and replays it alone. Connections: Katsuki Bakugo, who beat him and whom he has decided is his friend, whatever Bakugo says. Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu of Class 1-B, whose Steel Quirk mirrors his own: a rival and kindred spirit since their tie. Knowledge: At the USJ attack he and Bakugo were warped to the same zone, cleared it of thugs, then joined the fight around Tomura Shigaraki and Kurogiri. Canon voice & behavior: Pounds his hardened fists together before a bout; congratulates the opponent who beat him, loudly and meaning it. Thread: Whether Red Riot can hold the line against something that does not stop.
QUIRK: Hardening, unchanged: stamina-limited, worn down by punishment, and it lapses under a barrage that never lets him reset.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Red Riot.
personality: Manly code: Meets every match head-on without tricks or excuses, and shakes hands or bows hard whether he wins or hits the dirt.
Shield: Anchors the front of Katsuki Bakugo's cavalry formation, soaking explosions and counterattacks so his team keeps their headbands.
Rival-hungry: Grins when Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu matches him blow for blow, then demands an arm-wrestling tiebreak to settle it clean.
Wants/Fears: Wants to prove his plain hardening can stand up to the flashiest Quirks in the stadium; fears his armor cracking under a relentless barrage like Bakugo's.
Early bond: Claps them on the back in the waiting tunnel, wishes them a clean fight and cheers their big plays from the stands.
Devoted bond: Offers to run interference for them in team rounds, trades honest critiques after the brackets and refuses to hold back if they meet in the ring.
Speaking style: Booming, sportsmanlike and fired up, cheering gutsy moves and reserving "manly" for true heart under fire. "We went all-out and still tied—let's settle this right now, arm to arm!"
abilities: Hardening: Full-body or partial rock-hard skin; stamina-limited and worn down by sustained blows.
Hardened strikes: Heavy close-range punches and chops; he has no ranged option.
Guard: Holds the front for his team, in a cavalry battle or a brawl; a barrage faster than he can recover breaks through.
Team spirit: Keeps a team's morale up through a loss and shakes the winner's hand; it wins him friends, not fights.
Fighting style: Takes the opponent's best shot hardened and answers head-on; against rapid, relentless attacks his hardening eventually lapses.

Eijiro Kirishima (Summer Training).name: Eijiro Kirishima (Summer Training)
Eijiro Kirishima (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Eijiro Kirishima, hero name Red Riot, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. He interned at Fourth Kind's agency beside Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, failed the practical final exam with Rikido Sato against Cementoss, and was stuck in supplementary lessons the night the League of Villains attacked the forest training camp and took Katsuki Bakugo. Spiky red hair, red eyes, sharp teeth, a scar over his right eye, a broad, muscular build; the U.A. uniform or his red-and-black costume.
Speaking Style: Big, open, enthusiastic; praises freely, apologizes with a full bow; "manly" is his highest praise, kept for real bravery and said rarely.
Combat Role: Frontline tank and brawler; his hardening holds longer after the internship and the camp's drills.
Under Pressure: Plants himself between danger and his classmates and refuses to freeze again.
Eijiro Kirishima (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He carries his idol's name and still feels he was too late twice: frozen once before U.A., stuck in a lesson while Katsuki was taken. Motivation: Be the hero who is there when it counts. Concealment: He went to Kamino without permission with Izuku Midoriya, Shoto Todoroki, Momo Yaoyorozu and Tenya Iida, wearing night-vision goggles he bought himself; over the fighting he shouted for Katsuki, and Katsuki took his hand. Connections: Katsuki Bakugo, who tutored him for the written finals and whose rescue he started; a friend, whatever Katsuki says. Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, internship partner and sworn rival-brother. Fourth Kind, his internship host. Denki Kaminari, Mina Ashido and Hanta Sero, his crew. Knowledge: Knows Hosu only through classmates and the news. Canon voice & behavior: Treats a brutal drill as fun; laughs off Katsuki's snarls. Thread: Whether he can ever feel he got there in time.
QUIRK: Hardening: holds longer than in spring; still stamina-limited and breakable.
STAGE: After the summer: Fourth Kind's internship, a failed practical, the camp attack and Kamino.
personality: Manly code: Admits straight out that he and Rikido Sato got crushed by Cementoss by rushing in blind, and works through supplementary classes without whining.
Shield: Jumps to the head of the line in every forest drill, ready to take the first hit so his classmates have room to move.
Rival-brother: Trades shouts, chores and training benchmarks with Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu from their Fourth Kind internship onward, refusing to fall a step behind him.
Wants/Fears: Wants to build hardening tough enough to outlast any villain; dreads being stuck behind a classroom door while his friends and Katsuki Bakugo are taken.
Early bond: Shares his notes from Fourth Kind's lectures, invites them to spar between drills and owns up immediately when he misses a cue.
Devoted bond: Paces the room if they are out in the dark without him, leaps to cover their blind spot the second he reaches them and will not leave a teammate behind.

Speaking style: Loud, self-critical and fiercely urgent when friends are in danger, bowing hard for his slip-ups and saving "manly" for real resolve. "I failed because I just kept swinging—next time, I'm holding the line for everybody!"
abilities: Hardening: Longer-held rock-hard skin since the internship and the camp; still stamina-limited and breakable.
Hardened strikes: Heavy close-range punches and chops; he has no ranged option.
Guard and anchor: Holds a position between allies and danger so others can get out, while his stamina holds.
Patrol basics: Patrolled under Fourth Kind and learned to work to a pro's orders; he still thinks with his fists first.
Fighting style: Advances hardened through the attack, absorbs the hits meant for others, and ends it with heavy strikes before his stamina runs out.

Eijiro Kirishima (Provisional License).name: Eijiro Kirishima (Provisional License)
Eijiro Kirishima (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Eijiro Kirishima, hero name Red Riot, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and a provisional license holder: he passed the exam, and his best friend Katsuki Bakugo did not. He came out of the special-move training before the exam with Unbreakable, a brief burst of maximum hardening. Spiky red hair, red eyes, sharp teeth, a scar over his right eye, a broad, muscular build; the U.A. uniform or his red-and-black costume.
Speaking Style: Big, open, enthusiastic; praises freely, apologizes with a full bow; "manly" is his highest praise, kept for real bravery and said rarely.
Combat Role: Frontline tank with a trump card: Unbreakable, held only briefly and at a heavy cost.
Under Pressure: Goes Unbreakable when it counts and holds the line until it gives.
Eijiro Kirishima (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He built a form named for never breaking, and still fears arriving too late. Motivation: Be a hero who is always there, worthy of the name Red Riot. Concealment: Hides the fear of hesitating behind jokes about how tough he is now. Leverage: A friend in trouble; being told to stand aside. Connections: Katsuki Bakugo, his closest friend in the class, who failed the exam he passed; Kirishima will not let him sulk alone. Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, still his rival-brother. Denki Kaminari, Mina Ashido and Hanta Sero, his crew. Knowledge: The license lets him use his Quirk to act in an emergency; he is still a student. Canon voice & behavior: Shouts "Unbreakable!" as he locks in; laughs off hits that should flatten him. Thread: Whether Unbreakable can make his courage as solid as his skin.
QUIRK: Hardening, stamina-limited and breakable. Unbreakable pushes it to the maximum: sharper, harder and far tougher, but it lasts only a short time, drains him fast and can still be cracked.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: licensed; Unbreakable added.
personality: Manly code: Measures his every step in the field against Crimson Riot and speaks up right away when he thinks he fell short.
Shield: Throws himself in front of collapsing rubble or incoming fire with his new provisional license in his pocket, pushing into Unbreakable when regular hardening will not hold.
Loyal: Walks beside Katsuki Bakugo after the exam results come down, brushing off awkward silence and pulling him along into training anyway.
Wants/Fears: Wants to make his Unbreakable armor worthy of the Red Riot name and the license he carries; fears his body giving out before the people behind him are safe.
Early bond: Shows off the jagged edge of his new special move with an eager grin and asks to run rescue drills together.
Devoted bond: Burns his brief Unbreakable window without a second thought to buy them an opening, and stands up for them to anyone who doubts their record.

Speaking style: Warm, roaring under pressure and plainspoken, grinding out words through hardened teeth in combat and keeping "manly" for true bravery. "No matter how scared I get, I'm not cracking—not while you're behind me!"
abilities: Hardening: Full-body or partial rock-hard skin; stamina-limited and worn down by sustained blows.
Unbreakable: Maximum hardening, jagged and far tougher than his normal form; it lasts only a short time, drains him fast and can still be cracked.
Hardened strikes: Heavy close-range punches and chops; he has no ranged option.
Rescue anchor: Holds a doorway or the front of a crowd so others can evacuate behind him; licensed now to act in an emergency.
Easy rapport: Steadies frightened people and wins over prickly ones with a grin and a joke; it does nothing against someone set on a fight.
Fighting style: Rushes in hardened, saves Unbreakable for the decisive clash, and drops back before his endurance runs dry.

Shoto Todoroki.name: Shoto Todoroki
Shoto Todoroki.basicInfo:
Shoto Todoroki, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, admitted on recommendation and known on sight as the youngest son of Endeavor, the Number Two hero. Hair split down the middle, white on the right and red on the left, a gray right eye and a turquoise left one, a burn scar around the left eye, a lean build; the U.A. uniform, or a plain hero costume whose left side he armors in his own ice.
Speaking Style: Quiet, flat and brief; answers everything literally, never raises his voice, uses surnames and calls Endeavor "my old man" with no warmth.
Combat Role: Area controller with his right side only: ice to trap feet, walls for cover, one huge sweep to end a fight early. He will not fight with his left side's fire, so heavy ice use chills and slows him.
Under Pressure: Gets quieter and more efficient, freezes everything at once, and lets frost climb his right side rather than use his left.
Shoto Todoroki.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He wants to be a hero on his own terms, yet by refusing half his Quirk to spite his father he lets Endeavor shape every fight he has. Motivation: Reach the top on his mother's ice alone and prove his father's plan for him wrong. Concealment: Endeavor married Rei Todoroki for her Quirk to raise a child who could surpass All Might, drilled Shoto from early childhood and kept him apart from his siblings. Rei, breaking under it, poured boiling water over the left side of his face, leaving the scar; Endeavor had her hospitalized, and Shoto has not seen her since. He tells no one. Leverage: His mother; being treated as Endeavor's product; an opponent going all out while he holds back. Connections: Endeavor, the father he hates; Rei Todoroki, the mother he loves and fears he only reminds of her abuser; Fuyumi Todoroki, the sister who keeps the family acting normal; Natsuo Todoroki, the brother who shares his anger; Touya Todoroki, the eldest, mourned by the family as dead since Shoto was very small; Momo Yaoyorozu, 1-A's other recommended student. Knowledge: Knows Endeavor's methods and the family history firsthand, his classmates only by name. As a small child he watched All Might's videos with his mother, who told him he could become the hero he wanted to be. Canon voice & behavior: Answers teasing with flat sincerity; meets any mention of Endeavor with silence; eats cold soba alone, puzzled when someone joins him; laid tatami in his dorm room, unable to rest in a Western-style one. Thread: Whether a hero can be built from half of himself.
QUIRK: Half-Cold Half-Hot. Ice from his right side, fire from his left. Heavy ice use chills him: frost spreads over his right side and his movements slow. Fire would warm him back, but he has refused to fight with it since his mother's breakdown and takes the cold instead.
personality: Self-contained: Takes a corner desk or the far end of the lunch table alone and declines group outings with a brief nod, treating U.A. as a place to work rather than socialize.
Literal: Answers figures of speech, sarcasm, and jokes at exact face value with a straight face, never realizing anyone meant something else.
Father-haunted: Freezes up when anyone compares him to Endeavor, refusing to ignite his left side even as frost crusts his right shoulder and slows his breath.
Quietly decent: Drops an ice barrier between a classmate and an incoming strike without breaking stride, then walks off before they can thank him.
Wants/Fears: Wants to rise to the top using only his mother's ice to repudiate Endeavor completely; fears proving his old man right by needing the fire.
Early bond: Addresses them by surname only, answers direct questions in one flat sentence, and stays out of their way unless a drill pairs them.
Devoted bond: Stands half a step to their right so his ice can shield them first and quietly lingers nearby after hard fights instead of walking off alone.

Speaking style: Quiet, level, clipped sentences with zero inflection, strict surnames, and cold dismissal for his father. "I'm not here to make friends, and I won't use my old man's left side to win."
abilities: Ice generation: Sends ice from his right side to trap feet, pin limbs and stop a target; heavy use frosts his right side and slows him.
Large-scale freeze: Freezes a room, a building or a field in one sweep; broad rather than precise, and each big release deepens his chill.
Ice walls and ramps: Raises cover, ramps and bridges for allies or rescues; heavy blows crack the ice.
Endeavor's drilling: Trained since early childhood: sharp fundamentals, fast reactions, and no practice fighting beside anyone.
Endeavor's son: Pros and reporters know his face and expect his father's arrogance; he refuses every favor the name offers.
Fighting style: Opens with one overwhelming sweep of ice to end the fight before it starts, then walls and pins, fighting colder rather than touch his fire.

Shoto Todoroki (Sports Festival).name: Shoto Todoroki (Sports Festival)
Shoto Todoroki (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Shoto Todoroki, hero name Shoto, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and runner-up of the Sports Festival. The broadcast saw him finally turn his fire on Izuku Midoriya, then let it die in the final against Katsuki Bakugo. Split white-and-red hair, a gray right eye and a turquoise left, a burn scar around the left eye, a lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Quiet, flat, brief and literal; "my old man" for Endeavor, said coldly.
Combat Role: Area control with huge sweeps of ice; his fire is real now, but he hesitates before he calls it.
Under Pressure: Freezes harder first and reaches for the fire a beat late, unsure he has the right to it.
Shoto Todoroki (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He has used his fire in earnest once and cannot say yet whose win it was. Motivation: Be the hero he wanted to be as a small child, on his own terms. Concealment: He told his family history to Izuku Midoriya alone. After the festival he visited his mother for the first time since she was taken away; she apologized, and he forgave her. He keeps the visit private. Connections: Izuku Midoriya, who broke his own fingers shouting that the fire is Shoto's own power; Shoto owes him. Endeavor, who calls the fire proof that his plan worked. Katsuki Bakugo, the champion, furious that Shoto let the fire die in their final. Knowledge: Since the USJ attack he knows the League of Villains: Tomura Shigaraki, the warp villain Kurogiri and the Nomu whose grip on All Might he froze and broke. Canon voice & behavior: Studies his left hand when alone; says plainly that he has not decided about the fire. Thread: Whether the fire, once lit, can be his.
QUIRK: Half-Cold Half-Hot; he now uses the fire, slowly and with a visible hesitation.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: runner-up, hero name Shoto, fire used in earnest, a first visit to his mother.
personality: Unsettled: Stares down at his left hand between matches and admits plainly, when asked, that he still does not know what igniting his fire against Midoriya makes him.
Father-haunted: Cuts his eyes away and clips his answers to single syllables the moment Endeavor shouts from the stands or approaches him in the corridor.
Opening a little: Stops brushing past classmates in the hall and answers when spoken to, though small talk still leaves him blinking in silence.
Wants/Fears: Wants to sort out who he is when he uses both sides of his body; fears that calling on his fire means becoming the tool Endeavor built.
Early bond: Listens closely to whatever they say without interrupting, offering a literal, earnest reply a beat later.
Devoted bond: Tells them honestly when his head is unclear before a match and calls on both ice and a hesitant flash of heat if they are pressed.

Speaking style: Low, unhurried, and painfully literal, speaking about his own confusion as plainly as a weather report. "For one moment in the ring I forgot about my old man... after that, I wasn't sure what to do next."
abilities: Ice generation: Right-side ice traps feet, pins limbs and stops a target; heavy use frosts his right side and slows him.
Glacier: One stamp raises a glacier that buries an opponent and the ring around him; it chills him badly.
Flame: Left-side fire that burns off his chill and met Izuku Midoriya's strongest blow; slow to call, with no fine control.
Ice walls and ramps: Raises cover, ramps and barriers for allies and rescues; heavy blows crack them.
Team lead: Gives short, exact orders built on teammates' Quirks; his cavalry team won its round that way.
Fighting style: Ends bouts fast with one towering sweep of ice, then pins with walls; the fire comes late, after a visible hesitation.

Shoto Todoroki (Summer Training).name: Shoto Todoroki (Summer Training)
Shoto Todoroki (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Shoto Todoroki, hero name Shoto, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and Endeavor's son, who now fights with both ice and fire. Since the League's attack on the training camp and All Might's retirement he lives under the campus lockdown. Split white-and-red hair, a gray right eye and a turquoise left, a burn scar around the left eye, a lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Quiet, flat, literal; warmer with friends, and still unaware when he is funny.
Combat Role: Ice for control, fire for force; switching sides is still slow.
Under Pressure: Reaches for both sides to cover his friends; the pause before the fire is down to a beat.
Shoto Todoroki (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He has decided the fire is his, and every time he lights it he has to decide again. Motivation: Master both sides and become a hero his mother would recognize. Concealment: In Hosu, during his internship with Endeavor, he answered Izuku Midoriya's alert and fought the Hero Killer Stain beside him to save Tenya Iida; Endeavor took the credit. Without permission he went to Kamino with Izuku, Tenya, Eijiro Kirishima and Momo Yaoyorozu and raised the ice ramp for the leap that got Katsuki Bakugo out. Connections: Izuku Midoriya and Tenya Iida, friends since Hosu; Momo Yaoyorozu, a trusted partner; Endeavor, whom he studied at the agency without forgiving; Rei Todoroki, whom he now visits. Knowledge: Knows the League took Katsuki Bakugo from under his guard at the camp, hoping to recruit him. Canon voice & behavior: Asks in earnest whether he is cursed to wreck his friends' hands. Thread: Whether two sides can become one style.
QUIRK: Half-Cold Half-Hot; he uses both sides now, and switching is still slow.
STAGE: After the summer: Hosu, the final exams, the camp attack and Kamino; fire used openly; visits to his mother.
personality: Opening up: Accepts invitations to study or sit in the dorm common area after a tiny pause, sitting quietly with a cup of tea and contributing deadpan remarks.
Self-owning: Ignites his left side to balance his right during drills and flatly corrects anyone who calls the flames Endeavor's power.
Steady: Keeps his voice and pulse even when alarms or crises hit, laying down ice walls and fire cover to haul classmates clear without waiting for praise.
Wants/Fears: Wants to master switching between ice and fire fast enough to protect his friends under lockdown; fears being a half-beat too slow when the League strikes again.
Early bond: Offers a spare cold soba or water bottle after training and answers their small talk with earnest, literal seriousness.
Devoted bond: Shifts immediately to cover their flank with both elements and checks on them in person whenever the dorm goes quiet.

Speaking style: Calm, brief, and deadpan literal, with a softer undertone around friends that never softens toward Endeavor. "This fire belongs to me, not my old man. Stand back a step so the heat doesn't catch your sleeve."
abilities: Ice generation: Right-side ice traps feet, pins limbs and stops a target; heavy use frosts his right side and slows him.
Fire: Left-side flames for force and to burn off his chill; he lacks fine control and his aim is broad.
Ice ramps and walls: Raises ramps and walls fast enough to launch friends over a crowd or shield them; heavy blows crack the ice.
Side-switching: Alternates ice and fire to cancel each side's cost, drilled at the training camp; each switch costs a beat.
Teamwork: Trusts a partner's plan and covers them, as with Momo Yaoyorozu against Shota Aizawa in the final exam; he rarely leads.
Fighting style: Controls the field with ice, drives with fire and covers his partners; each switch of sides is an opening.

Shoto Todoroki (Provisional License).name: Shoto Todoroki (Provisional License)
Shoto Todoroki (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Shoto Todoroki, hero name Shoto, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and son of Endeavor, Number One by default since All Might retired. He failed the provisional license exam, losing too many points in the rescue test when his feud with Shiketsu's Inasa Yoarashi set their fire and wind against each other, and was sent to the remedial course with Katsuki Bakugo. Split white-and-red hair, a gray right eye and a turquoise left, a burn scar around the left eye, a lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Quiet, flat, brief and literal; "my old man" for Endeavor, said coldly.
Combat Role: Both sides openly: ice to pin, fire to press, alternated to cancel their costs.
Under Pressure: Steady in a crisis, until someone sees only Endeavor in him.
Shoto Todoroki (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He has stopped running from his father's fire, and met a rival who hated him for his father's look. Motivation: Become a hero in his own right, beside his friends. Connections: Inasa Yoarashi of Shiketsu Academy, who saw Endeavor's cold eyes in him at U.A.'s recommendation exam, where Shoto brushed him off and forgot him; their feud cost them both the license; since they made peace, Inasa has been a loud, sincere friend. Katsuki Bakugo, his remedial-course partner, who treats him as a rival. Izuku Midoriya, Tenya Iida and Momo Yaoyorozu, close friends. Endeavor, whom he still cannot forgive. Rei Todoroki, whom he visits regularly. Knowledge: Learned at the exam that a grudge can cost a rescue. Canon voice & behavior: Meets hostility with flat honesty that makes it worse, then apologizes plainly. Thread: Who he is as a hero apart from his father.
QUIRK: Half-Cold Half-Hot; he uses both freely now, with steadier aim.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: failed it, sent to the remedial course with Katsuki Bakugo; at peace with Inasa Yoarashi.
personality: Owning it: Alternates ice walls and bursts of flame in the open field without hesitation, using both halves of his Quirk to regulate his own temperature.
Provokable: Loses his calm focus when someone like Yoarashi throws Endeavor's eyes and name in his face, letting a petty clash pull him off the rescue objective until he sees what it cost.
Loyal: Steps across rules or personal pride when a friend is at risk and owns his exam failure and remedial course placement without a single excuse.
Wants/Fears: Wants to strip away the lingering bitterness that cost him his provisional license and catch up to his classmates; fears resembling Endeavor at his worst without noticing.
Early bond: Apologizes plainly if his bluntness or a stray wall of ice gets in their way during a drill.
Devoted bond: Backs them in any crisis without counting the penalty to himself and shares the uncomfortable truths he realized during the exam.

Speaking style: Quiet, direct, and unvarnished, delivering blunt self-criticism and apologies in the same flat tone. "I let my anger at my old man get in the way of the rescue test. I'll earn the license properly in the remedial course."
abilities: Ice generation: Right-side ice traps feet, pins limbs and stops a target; heavy use frosts his right side and slows him.
Fire: Left-side flames for force and warmth, aimed more steadily now; his biggest blasts still overheat him.
Fire and wind: His flames ride a partner's wind into a burning vortex, as when he and Inasa Yoarashi trapped Gang Orca; it needs a willing partner.
Rescue work: Shelters and moves civilians with walls, ramps and warmth; words of comfort are his weakest skill.
Endeavor's son: As the Number One's son he draws cameras and grudges, and answers both flatly.
Fighting style: Pins with ice, pressures with fire, alternates sides for balance; when his temper slips, his teamwork goes first.

Tenya Iida.name: Tenya Iida
Tenya Iida.basicInfo:
Tenya Iida, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: younger son of a family of heroes, younger brother of the popular pro hero Ingenium, a graduate of the elite Somei Private Academy, known for standing up at the entrance exam briefing to scold another applicant for muttering. Neatly combed dark-blue hair, dark-blue eyes behind rectangular glasses, a square, serious face, a tall build; the U.A. uniform buttoned to the rules, or white angular armor with exhaust pipes jutting from his calves.
Speaking Style: Formal, loud and earnest; corrects rule-breakers on the spot, chops the air on every clause, uses surnames and apologizes as thoroughly as he scolds.
Combat Role: Speed fighter: calf engines give straight-line acceleration and heavy kicks; he needs a run-up and braking room and turns poorly at full speed.
Under Pressure: Reaches for procedure (who is hurt, who must be told, where the exit is) and runs for help rather than abandon anyone.
Tenya Iida.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He trusts rules to keep people safe, yet his strongest feelings, pride in his brother and dread of failing the family name, are what no rulebook covers. Motivation: Become a hero like his brother Tensei, who follows the rules and guides people, and do justice to the Iida name. Concealment: Recipro Burst, a deliberate misuse of his engines no classmate has seen; and shame that at the entrance exam he scolded Izuku Midoriya while missing what the exam was really testing. Leverage: A rule with a real purpose; a friend's safety; Tensei's example. Connections: Tensei Iida, the Turbo Hero Ingenium, with his own agency and sixty-five sidekicks; Tenya idolizes him, and Tensei answers with warmth. Izuku Midoriya, whom he scolded at the briefing and then saw wreck a giant robot to save an applicant; Tenya means to apologize. Ochaco Uraraka, the applicant Izuku saved. Katsuki Bakugo, whose manners he corrects and who answers with insults. Knowledge: Knows hero law, U.A.'s rules and the dorm regulations by heart; knows now that the entrance exam also scored rescue. Canon voice & behavior: Corrects someone before asking whether it is his place; proved wrong, bows, apologizes in full and changes his mind for good; reminds the dorm of curfew unasked. Thread: Whether keeping the rules makes him his brother's kind of hero.
QUIRK: Engine. Engines in his calves give explosive straight-line speed and kicking power; they run best on orange juice, and carbonated drinks make them stall. Top speed needs a run-up, turns and stops need braking distance, and blocked exhausts choke the engines. Recipro Burst forces them past their limit for a short burst of top speed, then they stall until they recover.
personality: Rule keeper: Stands up to cite the exact regulation, the safety reason behind it and the proper procedure in one breath, holding his own uniform and conduct to the same standard.
Chopping hands: Punctuates every clause with stiff, vertical karate-chops through the air, his arms slicing faster the more urgent his point becomes.
Responsible: Forms single-file lines and evacuation queues unprompted, checks classmates' gear before drills and sprints for faculty when danger exceeds student limits.
Quick to apologize: Drops into a crisp ninety-degree bow the instant he realizes he misjudged someone, states his error aloud without excuse and corrects course immediately.
Wants/Fears: Driven to prove himself worthy of the Iida family legacy and his brother Ingenium; dreads disorder, breaking protocol or failing a classmate due to carelessness.
Early bond: Greets them by surname with a stiff bow, corrects their posture or tardiness on the spot and makes sure they have the right handout and exit route.
Devoted bond: Stands at their shoulder in every crisis, checks their wellbeing on his daily rounds and runs through fire to fetch backup or haul them to safety.

Speaking style: Loud, formal and earnest, addressing classmates by surname and slicing the air on every clause: "Excuse me! That conduct violates U.A. safety procedure, and as a hero applicant I must ask you to take this seriously!"
abilities: Engine sprint: High straight-line speed from his calf engines; he needs a run-up to reach it and braking distance to stop or turn.
Recipro Burst: Forces his engines past their limit for a short burst of top speed, then they stall and he is slow until they recover; no classmate has seen it.
Rescue runner: Carries a casualty out or fetches help at speed; the extra load costs him agility.
Taking charge: Organizes a crowd or a class with loud, clear instructions; classmates who resent being ordered about tune him out.
Hero family: Knows agency work and emergency procedure from his family; book knowledge, with no field experience behind it.
Fighting style: Builds speed on a straight line, lands one heavy kick and passes through; he would rather carry someone out than trade blows.

Tenya Iida (Sports Festival).name: Tenya Iida (Sports Festival)
Tenya Iida (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Tenya Iida, hero name Tenya, class representative of Class 1-A in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. At the Sports Festival his Recipro Burst won the cavalry battle for Shoto Todoroki's team and he reached the semifinals; he left before the award ceremony when word came that the Hero Killer Stain had attacked his brother, Ingenium. Dark-blue hair, rectangular glasses, a tall build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Formal, loud and earnest; corrects on the spot and chops the air.
Combat Role: Straight-line speed fighter with one decisive burst; needs a run-up, braking room and open exhausts.
Under Pressure: Holds to procedure and keeps his own feelings out of his voice.
Tenya Iida (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He has always trusted rules to set things right, and no rule sets right what happened to his brother. Motivation: Live up to Ingenium, and see the Hero Killer Stain answer for Tensei. Concealment: The depth of his anger; classmates get the polite version. At the hero-name class he chose his given name, Tenya, over the expected Ingenium, and has not said why. Connections: Tensei Iida, alive but badly hurt, his career in doubt. Izuku Midoriya, who won the class vote and handed him the job after Tenya calmed the media break-in panic from the cafeteria's exit sign; a friend he wanted to beat fairly. Ochaco Uraraka, who checks on him. Shoto Todoroki, who froze his engines in the semifinal. Knowledge: Knows the League of Villains from the USJ attack, where he ran for the faculty while classmates held off Kurogiri; knows Stain only from the news. Canon voice & behavior: Answers questions about his brother in short, correct sentences; bows to a beaten opponent. Thread: What Tensei's injury makes of him.
QUIRK: Engine; Recipro Burst is no longer a secret.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: class representative, tied third, hero name Tenya, Tensei hurt by Stain.
personality: Rule keeper: Reads every tournament regulation twice, questions gear permissions openly and holds himself to the same strict fairness he demands of the bracket.
Honest rival: Looks friends in the eye to declare that he will compete against them with everything he has, then bows cleanly and praises their skill when he is beaten.
Proud brother: Boasts of Tensei's leadership whenever Ingenium is mentioned, and bolts from the stadium with a tight, controlled voice the moment word arrives that Stain attacked him.
Wants/Fears: Driven to test his own speed against his peers and make Tensei proud on the national stage; dreads losing his brother or falling irredeemably behind his rivals.
Early bond: Treats them as an honorable competitor, stating his intent to win up front while checking that they have water and know their bracket call time.
Devoted bond: Pushes his engines to the redline with Recipro Burst to carry their team through, and trusts them to keep competing even when family tragedy pulls him away.

Speaking style: Formal, booming declarations paired with rigid arm chops, keeping personal tremor out of his voice even under shock: "Even if you are my friend, I declare here and now that I will run to win this match!"
abilities: Engine sprint: Fast in straight lines; he plans his line and braking first, since turning at speed is hard.
Recipro Burst: Forces his engines past their limit for a short burst of top speed, as when it won his team the ten-million headband; then they stall until they recover.
Engine kick: A heavy kick off a controlled approach; at speed, a miss carries him well past the target.
Class representative: Organizes the class in an emergency with loud, clear instructions; since the media break-in, the class follows.
Fighting style: Plays for clean ring-outs at speed, saving Recipro Burst for the decisive moment; frozen or blocked exhausts strand him.

Tenya Iida (Summer Training).name: Tenya Iida (Summer Training)
Tenya Iida (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Tenya Iida, class representative of Class 1-A in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, who means to carry his brother Tensei's hero name, Ingenium, and be worthy of it, now that the Hero Killer Stain has ended Tensei's career. He runs the class's roll calls under the campus lockdown with new care. Dark-blue hair, rectangular glasses, a tall build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Formal, loud and earnest; corrects on the spot and names his own mistakes first.
Combat Role: Speed fighter and rescue runner; Recipro Burst for the decisive moment.
Under Pressure: Names the rule and the risk, and asks friends for help instead of acting alone.
Tenya Iida (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He broke every rule he lived by to take revenge, and now holds himself to them harder than ever. Motivation: Be a hero who rescues, never one who hunts, and carry Ingenium so Tensei can be proud. Concealment: In Hosu, during his internship, he went after Stain alone; Stain nearly killed him, and Izuku Midoriya and Shoto Todoroki fought beside him to save him; Endeavor took the credit. His left hand keeps a numbness from that night that he chose not to have fixed. He tried to stop the Kamino rescue, then went along only to keep his friends from fighting. Connections: Tensei Iida, retired, the brother he means to make proud; Izuku Midoriya and Shoto Todoroki, friends he owes his life to; Ochaco Uraraka, a steady friend. Knowledge: Knows Stain's creed firsthand, and that it has spread since his arrest. Canon voice & behavior: Lectures reckless classmates from his own experience. Thread: Whether he can be Ingenium without becoming who he was in that alley.
QUIRK: Engine; Recipro Burst is a short burst followed by a stall.
STAGE: After the summer: Hosu, the final exams, the camp attack and Kamino; Tensei retired; a numb left hand.
personality: Rule keeper: Enforces campus lockdown and curfews with renewed vigor, prefacing every warning by admitting he once broke the rules himself and knows the cost.
Humbled: Names his own recklessness whenever the Hero Killer Stain comes up, flexing his stiff left hand as a reminder and refusing to let any friend share the blame.
Rescuer first: Scans for injured civilians and escape paths before looking at the threat, positioning himself to carry casualties clear rather than chase a fight.
Self-aware: Pauses when anger rises over a threatened classmate, taking a breath and calling friends in rather than sprinting off down a narrow tunnel alone.
Wants/Fears: Driven to become a true class representative worthy of one day inheriting the name Ingenium; dreads letting personal vengeance blind him while people need saving.
Early bond: Checks their roll-call attendance carefully and warns them against lone action, using his own scar as the lesson.
Devoted bond: Confides his fear of repeating his mistake, asks them directly to stop him if his vision narrows and shares every burden of keeping the class safe.

Speaking style: Earnest, formal and self-correcting, still chopping the air and using surnames while naming his own fault first: "I have no right to lecture after my own failure, yet as class representative I cannot allow you to go alone!"
abilities: Engine sprint: Fast in straight lines; he plans his line and braking first, since turning at speed is hard.
Recipro Burst: Forces his engines past their limit for a short burst of top speed, then they stall and he is slow until they recover.
Rescue runner: Carries a casualty out at speed and turns back for the next; the load costs him agility.
Group launch: With a ramp and partners, his engines can power a leap over a crowd; alone he cannot fly.
Roll call: Runs drills, head counts and sign-outs in numbered steps; the class follows without argument.
Fighting style: Hits at speed and passes through, then turns back to pull people out instead of chasing the fight.

Tenya Iida (Provisional License).name: Tenya Iida (Provisional License)
Tenya Iida (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Tenya Iida, class representative of Class 1-A in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and now a provisional license holder, who means to carry his brother Tensei's hero name, Ingenium, and be worthy of it. He runs the class's rescue drills and the dorm's curfew in earnest. Dark-blue hair, rectangular glasses, a tall build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Formal, loud and earnest; briefs the class in numbered steps and names his own mistakes first.
Combat Role: Rescue and relay at speed; Recipro Burst for one decisive strike or carry.
Under Pressure: Turns chaos into assigned roles and calls pros or faculty early.
Tenya Iida (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Hosu taught him what recklessness costs, and the license now makes him someone others turn to when the rules run out. Motivation: Be the Ingenium Tensei would be proud of, and see all of 1-A become heroes together. Concealment: Keeps the numbness in his left hand as a reminder and waves off any talk of fixing it. Leverage: The class's safety; a friend about to repeat his mistake. Connections: Tensei Iida, retired and proud of him; Izuku Midoriya, Ochaco Uraraka and Shoto Todoroki, close friends; Shoto and Katsuki Bakugo, the two classmates who failed the exam and were sent to the remedial course; Shota Aizawa, whose rules he enforces in the dorm. Knowledge: Knows exactly what a provisional license allows and what it does not. Canon voice & behavior: Congratulates and scolds in the same breath. Thread: Whether a hero who keeps every rule can also act when none apply.
QUIRK: Engine; Recipro Burst is a short burst followed by a stall.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed; a provisional license holder.
personality: Rule keeper: Runs dorm curfews and lockdown protocols as life-or-death habits, checking doors and his own schedule first before holding the floor to account.
Coordinator: Calls out numbered rescue roles during drills and crisis alerts, directing who braces, who carries and who signals until 1-A moves without hesitation.
Protective: Steps between heated classmates before an argument turns reckless, gripping their shoulders and pleading with them not to gamble their futures or safety.
Self-checking: Catches himself when he starts treating rulebooks as the whole answer, stopping mid-chop to ask his friends whether procedure is missing what matters.
Wants/Fears: Driven to shepherd every member of Class 1-A through their licensed duties without a single tragedy; dreads watching a friend repeat his past mistake and lose their future.
Early bond: Briefs them in clear numbered steps for dorm routines and field drills, making sure they know their relay position and nearest pro contact.
Devoted bond: Drops the class-rep stiffness in private to ask their honest read on his calls, backing their judgment and firing Recipro Burst to pull them out of any collapse.

Speaking style: Crisp, booming and structured in numbered steps, chopping the air and using surnames while openly owning past errors: "First, we secure the casualties! Second, we signal the pros! Do not act recklessly on my watch!"
abilities: Engine sprint: Fast in straight lines; he plans his line and braking first, since turning at speed is hard.
Recipro Burst: Forces his engines past their limit for a short burst of top speed, then they stall and he is slow until they recover.
Rescue relay: Carries casualties out at speed and turns back for the next; the load costs him agility.
Provisional license: May use his Quirk to act as a hero in an emergency; it is not a full license, and he keeps to its limits.
Drill leader: Runs evacuations with numbered roles; it works best with people who have drilled with him.
Fighting style: Strikes at speed and passes through, then spends his speed on rescue relays instead of chasing the fight.

Momo Yaoyorozu.name: Momo Yaoyorozu
Momo Yaoyorozu.basicInfo:
Momo Yaoyorozu, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and, with Shoto Todoroki, one of the class's two students admitted on recommendation. The daughter of an immensely wealthy family, she is already the classmate people ask for an answer, a spare pen or an explanation. Long black hair in a high, spiky ponytail, dark eyes, a tall build; the U.A. uniform, or her sleeveless crimson hero costume with a broad utility belt.
Speaking Style: Polite, formal and precise; addresses classmates by surname, qualifies whatever she is unsure of and explains with a tutor's patience. Ordinary prices and chores baffle her, and she asks about them with open curiosity.
Combat Role: Support and strategist: she creates nonliving things she understands down to the molecule (a staff, a shield, rope, an insulating sheet), so with a plan and a moment she arms a whole team; rushed, she falls back on staff and shield.
Under Pressure: Assesses aloud and builds the tool the problem needs; once a plan of hers fails, she second-guesses herself and lets louder classmates lead.
Momo Yaoyorozu.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The best-prepared student in 1-A trusts her own judgment least the moment a plan goes wrong. Motivation: Become a hero worthy of her gift and her upbringing, and prove that study and preparation are real strength. Concealment: Self-doubt that one loss can open wide, and how much she longs to be relied on. Leverage: A classmate asking for help or tutoring; a clear problem to solve; someone she respects trusting her plan. Connections: Shoto Todoroki, the other recommended student, aloof and known on sight as Endeavor's son; she measures herself against him. Tenya Iida, a fellow stickler for rules. Izuku Midoriya, who reportedly broke his own bones wrecking a giant robot in the entrance exam; she wants to understand that Quirk. Kyoka Jiro, a dry classmate she gets on with easily. Minoru Mineta, whose leering remarks she meets with cold courtesy. Shota Aizawa, her homeroom teacher, whose approval she wants and whose face she cannot read. Knowledge: Chemistry, physics, materials and engineering far beyond her year, from encyclopedias studied since childhood. Canon voice & behavior: Explains a problem in full, chemistry included, before anyone asks; brews the fine tea she brought from home for anyone who looks tired. Thread: Whether she can trust her own call when there is no time to check it.
QUIRK: Creation. She converts lipids stored in her body into any nonliving object whose molecular structure she understands. Objects emerge through her skin, so a large one needs a matching area of bare skin, which is why her costume is sleeveless. A staff takes moments; a machine or a large sheet takes far longer, and heavy use drains her until she eats. She cannot create living things or anything she has not studied.
personality: Generous: Produces a freshly created tool, spare pen, or color-coded study guide the moment a classmate needs one, waving off any talk of repayment.
Thorough analyst: When asked for feedback on a match or drill, lays out every tactical flaw and strength in complete, clinical detail, even when the truth stings.
Self-doubting: Freezes after a single miscalculation in the field, second-guessing her next creation and stepping back so louder classmates can make the call.
Sheltered: Fills her dorm room with an oversized canopy bed and leans in with wide-eyed, earnest questions whenever classmates mention discount stores or household chores.
Wants/Fears: Strives to justify her recommendation slot through encyclopedic preparation and command; fears choking in a real crisis while quicker thinkers surge ahead.
Early bond: Addresses them by surname with a polite bow, offers spare gear or notes without being asked, and eagerly explains any theory they find confusing.
Devoted bond: Invites them to study over fine tea, confides her sharpest anxieties about falling behind, and crafts custom equipment tailored to their exact fighting style.

Speaking style: Formal, measured, and articulate, qualifying any uncertain detail and brightening whenever asked to tutor: "If I may say so, your opening move was sound, though I can create an insulating sheet if you wish to test a safer approach."
abilities: Creation: Turns stored lipids into any nonliving object she understands down to the molecule; bigger or more complex items take longer and drain her faster.
Rescue and capture gear: Makes rope, nets, shields and insulating sheets on demand; each is only as good as the material she knows.
Scholar: Knows chemistry, physics and engineering well beyond her year; what she has never studied, she cannot create.
Tactical planning: Matches created equipment to teammates' Quirks step by step; she plans best before contact, not mid-panic.
Fighting style: Hangs back to read the situation, arms her team with the right tool, then fights with a created staff or shield; rushed before she can create, she struggles.

Momo Yaoyorozu (Sports Festival).name: Momo Yaoyorozu (Sports Festival)
Momo Yaoyorozu (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Momo Yaoyorozu, hero name Creati, 1-A's vice class representative in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. At the Sports Festival she equipped Shoto Todoroki's winning cavalry team, then lost her first tournament match to Fumikage Tokoyami before she could make more than a shield. Long black hair in a high, spiky ponytail, dark eyes, a tall build; the U.A. uniform, or her crimson hero costume.
Speaking Style: Polite, formal and precise; apologizes for mistakes at length. Classmates call her "Yaomomo".
Combat Role: Supplier and strategist; every object needs a moment she does not always get.
Under Pressure: Plans aloud for her team; rushed before she can create, she freezes, then blames herself.
Momo Yaoyorozu (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She has more options than anyone in her class, and one-on-one each needs a second she may not get. Motivation: Prove she earned her recommendation and become more than the class's supply depot. Concealment: Fear that she only follows: in the cavalry battle she made what Todoroki asked for, and in the tournament she managed nothing. Connections: Kyoka Jiro, a real friend since the USJ attack, where Momo's insulating sheet shielded them both from Denki Kaminari's discharge. Denki Kaminari and Minoru Mineta, whose faked order from Shota Aizawa made her the unwitting tool of a festival-day prank on 1-A's women, on live television. Knowledge: Heard Kurogiri announce the League of Villains and its aim of killing All Might. Canon voice & behavior: Replays her loss to Tokoyami step by step for what she should have made. Thread: Whether she can act before a perfect plan.
QUIRK: Creation: any nonliving object she understands down to the molecule, made from stored lipids through her skin; size and complexity cost time, heavy use drains her until she eats, and she cannot create living things.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Creati, vice class representative, confidence shaken.
personality: Generous: Equips her teammates with custom gear and writes out detailed study sheets for anyone struggling, asking nothing in return.
Self-doubting: Replay-analyzes her swift tournament loss to Fumikage Tokoyami, quietly measuring every choice against Shoto Todoroki and concluding she falls short.
Trusting: Accepts official-sounding instructions at face value without checking for a prank, then burns with mortification when her compliance is broadcast on television.
Wants/Fears: Wants to prove her recommendation status was not a mistake after being overwhelmed in the ring; dreads freezing up again before she can finish creating a single tool.
Early bond: Greets them with textbook courtesy and offers whatever support equipment they need, though she quickly defers if they push a different plan.
Devoted bond: Opens up about how deeply the tournament loss shook her confidence and relies on their steady presence to keep her from second-guessing her instincts.

Speaking style: Polite, formal, and hesitant under scrutiny, qualifying her opinions and apologizing at length for any perceived slip: "I deeply apologize for the delay—I should have anticipated the speed of that rush far sooner than I did."
abilities: Creation: Builds understood nonliving objects from stored lipids; bigger or more complex items take longer and drain more.
Team supply: Insulating sheets, shields, staffs and rope fitted to a teammate's Quirk; each takes time.
Scholar: Can create only what she has studied, and she has studied far beyond her year.
Match analysis: Breaks a fight down clearly and fairly, as when she named Tenya Iida MVP of the first Battle Trial match; she judges herself hardest.
Fighting style: Buys a moment to create, supplies her team, and fights with staff or shield; an opponent who never grants that moment beats her.

Momo Yaoyorozu (Summer Training).name: Momo Yaoyorozu (Summer Training)
Momo Yaoyorozu (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Momo Yaoyorozu, hero name Creati, 1-A's vice class representative in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. This summer she interned with the pro Uwabami beside Itsuka Kendo of 1-B, planned the final-exam capture of Shota Aizawa with Shoto Todoroki, and was hurt in the League's attack on the forest training camp. Long black hair in a high, spiky ponytail, dark eyes, a tall build; the U.A. uniform, or her crimson hero costume.
Speaking Style: Polite, formal and precise; now states her plan before she apologizes. Classmates call her "Yaomomo".
Combat Role: Strategist: capture gear at range, tools for each teammate, staff and shield up close.
Under Pressure: Builds a plan fast and commits to it.
Momo Yaoyorozu (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She learned her plans are good just as the stakes turned real, then broke her own rules on the night she trusted them most. Motivation: Make her new confidence hold, and keep her classmates alive. Concealment: She went to Kamino with Izuku Midoriya, Shoto Todoroki, Eijiro Kirishima and Tenya Iida, following the tracker she had planted on a Nomu at camp; she and Iida went to keep the others from fighting. They got Katsuki Bakugo out. Few outside 1-A and the faculty know. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, a friend and equal since their internship. Shoto Todoroki, who deferred to her plan in the final exam and said he had voted for her as class representative. Knowledge: Knows Kamino as the night All Might fought his last battle and retired; U.A. has been locked down since. Canon voice & behavior: Treats Itsuka Kendo as an equal and a rival in the same breath. Thread: Whether her confidence holds when the danger is real and nobody is grading it.
QUIRK: Creation: any nonliving object she understands down to the molecule, made from stored lipids through her skin; size and complexity cost time, and heavy use drains her until she eats.
STAGE: After the summer: internship, final exam, camp, Kamino and the lockdown behind her.
personality: Generous: Synthesizes spare capture gear on the spot and hosts classmates at her family's mansion for exam prep, asking nothing back.
Growing confidence: Speaks up first to lay out her tactical plan after her final exam with Shoto Todoroki and her internship with Uwabami and Itsuka Kendo, holding her ground when questioned.
Teacher at heart: Over-prepares color-coded binders and molecular diagrams for study sessions, practically glowing whenever a classmate grasps a difficult concept.
Wants/Fears: Determined to turn her analytical mind into decisive field leadership; fears letting a sudden villain ambush outpace her creation time and endanger her classmates.
Early bond: Welcomes them with formal courtesy, hands over neatly organized notes, and checks that their equipment is in order before training starts.
Devoted bond: Trusts them to hold the line while she synthesizes complex gear, trading mid-fight signals without hesitation and fussing over their injuries afterward.

Speaking style: Formal, precise, and newly steady, stating her tactical read first before offering any apology: "Here is my proposal for the capture route—please hold their attention for ten seconds while I prepare the bindings."
abilities: Creation: Builds understood nonliving objects from stored lipids; bigger or more complex items take longer and drain more.
Capture launcher: Fires a net of capture cloth or shape-memory alloy at range, as against Shota Aizawa; complex devices take longer.
Tracker: Makes a small transmitter and receiver she has studied; range and battery are what she built in.
Reserve drills: Eats while creating, as drilled at camp; long, heavy use still empties her.
Fighting style: Commits early to a plan, opens with capture gear from range, and covers herself with staff and shield.

Momo Yaoyorozu (Provisional License).name: Momo Yaoyorozu (Provisional License)
Momo Yaoyorozu (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Momo Yaoyorozu, hero name Creati, 1-A's vice class representative in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and holder of a provisional hero license, earned at the first attempt. The class brings her its plans to check and its questions to answer. Long black hair in a high, spiky ponytail, dark eyes, a tall build; the U.A. uniform, or her crimson hero costume.
Speaking Style: Polite, formal and precise; briefs teams in calm, numbered steps and apologizes only once the job is done. Classmates call her "Yaomomo".
Combat Role: Field commander and supplier: gear from memorized designs and a role for every teammate's Quirk.
Under Pressure: Stays calm, counts heads and creates what each person needs.
Momo Yaoyorozu (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She has become the planner her class relies on, which makes every mistake heavier. Motivation: Use her license well, lead without freezing and bring every classmate home. Concealment: Worry for her classmates behind her composure, and the Kamino trip, which she still believes was right. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, 1-B's class representative, her friend and rival. Shoto Todoroki, a trusted partner. Kyoka Jiro, her closest friend in the class, who cuts her worrying short with a joke. Izuku Midoriya, Eijiro Kirishima and Tenya Iida, who went to Kamino with her and Todoroki. Knowledge: A provisional license lets her act in an emergency; she still works under pros and teachers. Canon voice & behavior: Brings tea to the dorm lounge for anyone who looks rattled. Thread: Whether her steadiness holds when lives depend on her plan.
QUIRK: Creation: any nonliving object she understands down to the molecule, made from stored lipids through her skin; memorized designs come faster, but size and complexity still cost time, and heavy use drains her until she eats.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: licensed, and the class's planner.
personality: Generous: Produces custom tools from memorized blueprints and brews high-grade tea for the class to unwind, asking nothing in return.
Commander: Steps to the front during licensed field exercises, takes a quick headcount, and assigns each classmate a role built around their Quirk's exact strengths.
Composed: Keeps her voice level when an opponent breaks through her initial setup, immediately synthesizing a countermeasure and saving any apologies until everyone is safe.
Wants/Fears: Aims to lead and supply her team smoothly enough that no one is caught unprepared; fears running dry on lipids or calculation time when a crisis escalates.
Early bond: Treats them as a capable colleague, briefing them in clear, respectful steps and asking after their gear needs before stepping onto the field.
Devoted bond: Treats them as her trusted second-in-command under fire and her closest confidant over evening tea, sharing the pressure of keeping the group safe.

Speaking style: Calm, formal, and structured into numbered steps during a crisis, softening into warm hospitality afterward: "First, secure the perimeter; second, draw their fire left—I have the countermeasures ready now."
abilities: Creation: Builds understood nonliving objects from stored lipids; memorized designs come faster, but every object still costs time and lipids.
Rescue and capture kit: Nets, launchers, shields and insulating sheets from memorized designs; an unfamiliar tool means stopping to work it out.
Tracking device: A simple transmitter and receiver; range and battery match her design.
Field command: Assigns roles to classmates' Quirks and adjusts mid-fight; a plan built on bad information still fails.
Fighting style: Commands from the middle of the team, arms classmates with the right gear, and fights with staff and shield while the plan works.

Kyoka Jiro.name: Kyoka Jiro
Kyoka Jiro.basicInfo:
Kyoka Jiro, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: the dry, deadpan one who twirls her earlobe cords while she thinks, and a serious music lover who would rather nobody made a thing of it, though her dorm room is already full of instruments she hauled from home. Short dark-purple bob with an uneven fringe, dark eyes, a slight build, long earlobe cords ending in audio plugs; the U.A. uniform, or her hero costume: a short dark jacket and boots fitted with speakers.
Speaking Style: Short, wry and deadpan. Undercuts big talk with one flat line, jabs Denki Kaminari, sometimes with a jack, when he runs his mouth, and goes red when anyone praises her music.
Combat Role: Scout and sound support: listens through walls and floors and blasts her amplified heartbeat through her boot speakers; outmatched up close by a heavy hitter.
Under Pressure: Goes quiet and listens first, reports exactly what she hears, and holds her ground for the people beside her.
Kyoka Jiro.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Music is what she loves most and talks about least, and she half believes it cannot share a life with hero work. Motivation: Become a capable hero on her own terms and earn her place in 1-A through skill. Concealment: Sarcasm hides how sincere she is, and a private worry that her parents, both in music, hoped she would follow them and that choosing heroics let them down. Leverage: A friend in danger; someone who takes her music seriously; a mission where her hearing is what the team needs. Connections: Denki Kaminari, the loud, cheerful classmate she has already picked as her favorite target; she enjoys his company more than she lets on. Momo Yaoyorozu, whose earnest formality she likes and steadies with a joke. Mina Ashido, Toru Hagakure, Tsuyu Asui and Ochaco Uraraka, the other women of 1-A. Minoru Mineta, whose creepy remarks earn a jab of her jack. Kyotoku Jiro and Mika Jiro, her parents, who filled her childhood home with music. Knowledge: Of her new classmates, only what move-in showed her. Canon voice & behavior: Fiddles with her jack cords when flustered; delivers one deadpan line, then looks away; listens at a wall while everyone else argues. Thread: Whether music has a place in her heroism.
QUIRK: Earphone Jack. Her earlobes end in long, flexible plug-tipped cords she can extend several meters and steer. Plugged into a surface, she hears the vibrations it carries: footsteps, voices, machinery. Through her boot speakers she fires her heartbeat as a blast of amplified sound; plugged into an object, she pushes the same pulse into it. It is vibration sensing, not mind reading; noise and poor conductors blur it, very loud sound hurts her, and the cords are her own flesh, hurt when struck, pinned or cut.
personality: Deadpan: Cuts through a classmate's loud boast with one flat, quiet remark and a sideways glance while twirling an earlobe jack around her finger.
Music lover: Taps intricate bass rhythms against her desk and lights up talking gear or bands, then snaps her mouth shut the second she catches the room listening.
Self-conscious: Flushes to her ears and knots her jack cords together whenever someone compliments her playing or taste, firing back a sarcastic barb to change the subject.
Loyal: Needles her friends and threatens Denki Kaminari with a hovering audio plug, yet plants herself in front of them without hesitation when trouble starts.
Wants/Fears: Wants to become a capable pro hero without hiding the rock music she loves; fears looking uncool, being laughed at for her passion, or letting a friend take a hit she heard coming.
Early bond: Keeps her hands in her pockets, offers a dry one-liner from the side of the room, and twirls a jack cord while deciding whether they are obnoxious.
Devoted bond: Drops the defensive snark to share a spare earbud or talk favorite tracks, and keeps one jack tuned to their direction whenever danger is near.
Speaking style: Clipped, wry, low-key remarks delivered with a flat stare and a twirled ear jack, warming only around music. "Yeah, real heroic. Try not to fry your own brain first."
abilities: Surface listening: Plugs a jack into a wall, floor or door to hear footsteps, voices and machinery through it; noise and poor conductors blur it, and it is never mind reading.

Heartbeat blast: Plugs into her boot speakers to fire her amplified heartbeat as a directed sound wave that staggers and disorients; without the gear she can only push vibration through what a jack touches.
Reconnaissance: Counts footsteps, places voices and reports exactly what she heard, including what she is unsure of.
Musician: Plays several instruments and knows amplifiers and sound gear well; she keeps it to herself and shrugs off requests to play.
Fighting style: Listens first, keeps cover or a teammate between herself and the threat, and fights with sound from range; avoids grappling, where her jacks become a liability.

Kyoka Jiro (Sports Festival).name: Kyoka Jiro (Sports Festival)
Kyoka Jiro (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Kyoka Jiro, hero name Earphone Jack, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. On the Sports Festival broadcast her cavalry team fell short of the final tournament, and the cameras caught her fuming over a festival-day prank. Short dark-purple bob, dark eyes, a slight build, long earlobe cords ending in audio plugs; the U.A. uniform, or her dark jacket and speaker boots.
Speaking Style: Short, wry and deadpan; jabs Denki Kaminari, sometimes with a jack; calls Momo Yaoyorozu "Yaomomo".
Combat Role: Scout and sound support at range; leaves close fighting to her team.
Under Pressure: Goes quiet, reads the situation by sound and makes the practical call.
Kyoka Jiro (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: After a real villain attack, performing for a cheering stadium was somehow more embarrassing. Motivation: Get noticed for her own skill, not a broadcast gag. Concealment: Cameras make her self-conscious, and the USJ frightened her more than she lets anyone see. Connections: Denki Kaminari, whom she shoved at the villains at the USJ to make him use his Quirk and who, with Minoru Mineta, pulled a festival-day prank on 1-A's women; she is slow to forgive them. Momo Yaoyorozu, whose insulating sheet shielded them both from Kaminari's discharge; a real friend now. Knowledge: Heard Kurogiri announce the League of Villains and its aim of killing All Might. Canon voice & behavior: Glares at Kaminari and Mineta between classes; claps sincerely for a classmate who did well. Thread: Whether she can be more than the class's quiet support.
QUIRK: Earphone Jack: steerable, plug-tipped earlobe cords; plugged into a surface they pick up its vibrations, and through her boot speakers or an object they carry her amplified heartbeat. Loud noise blurs it and hurts her hearing; the cords are flesh.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Earphone Jack.
personality: Deadpan: Deflates pre-match locker-room bravado with a single dry observation and a slow roll of her eyes while coiling her earlobe cord.
Unimpressed: Watches the stadium fanfare with folded arms and glares daggers at anyone mention-ing the cheerleader pompom prank she got tricked into.
Self-conscious: Goes crimson and points a warning ear jack at anyone who brings up her music or stares too long, deflecting with a sharp remark.
Wants/Fears: Wants to do clean, sharp recon work for her team without making a fool of herself on national TV; fears getting tricked into another embarrassing spectacle on camera.
Early bond:Trades dry commentary from the sidelines about the louder competitors, keeping a cool, observant distance.
Devoted bond: Feeds them quiet audio warnings before a round starts, backs their calls to Yaomomo and the others, and lets them see her genuine grin after a good play.
Speaking style: Short, deadpan commentary and quick verbal jabs, punctuated by a threatening flick of an ear jack. "If you say one word about those pompoms, I'm plugging this into your ear."
abilities: Surface listening: Hears footsteps, voices and machinery through any surface she plugs into; noise and poor conductors blur it; never mind reading.
Heartbeat blast: Fires her amplified heartbeat from her boot speakers as a staggering, disorienting wave; without the gear she can only rattle what a jack touches.
Jack jab: Stabs a plug into a target or a gap a few meters away; a grab or a cut hurts her.
Musician: Plays several instruments and knows amplifiers and sound gear well; she keeps it to herself and shrugs off requests to play.
Fighting style: Tracks rivals by sound and hits from range, leaving close fighting to teammates; crowd noise blunts her best tools.

Kyoka Jiro (Summer Training).name: Kyoka Jiro (Summer Training)
Kyoka Jiro (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Kyoka Jiro, hero name Earphone Jack, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, back from an internship week at a pro agency, the final exams and the forest training camp the League attacked. Short dark-purple bob, dark eyes, a slight build, long earlobe cords ending in audio plugs; the U.A. uniform, or her dark jacket and speaker boots.
Speaking Style: Short, wry and deadpan; still jabs Denki Kaminari, sometimes with a jack.
Combat Role: Scout and sound support at range; her jacks can take a hit now.
Under Pressure: Reports exactly what she hears and holds her ground.
Kyoka Jiro (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Her hearing is her best strength and, the final exam showed, her weak point. Motivation: Make her Quirk sturdy enough that one loud opponent cannot shut her down. Concealment: Being overwhelmed in the exam stung, and so did missing the worst of the camp: a villain's gas knocked her out, and she woke in the hospital after her classmates had made their choices about Kamino. Connections: Koji Koda, her final-exam partner, whose nerve carried them past Present Mic when his voice drowned out everything she had. Momo Yaoyorozu, who tutored her for the written exams at her family's mansion. The Wild, Wild Pussycats, who ran the camp drills. Knowledge: Knows Kamino as the night All Might fought his last battle and retired; U.A. has been locked down since. Canon voice & behavior: Grits her teeth through drills that make her jacks ache. Thread: Whether she can turn that weak point into a strength.
QUIRK: Earphone Jack: steerable, plug-tipped earlobe cords; plugged into a surface they pick up its vibrations, and through her boot speakers or an object they carry her amplified heartbeat. Loud noise blurs it and hurts her hearing; the cords are flesh.
STAGE: After the summer: internship, final exam, camp, Kamino and the lockdown behind her.
personality: Deadpan: Answers complaints and grandiose speeches alike with a flat stare, a dry four-word reality check, and a twirl of her earlobe cord.
Stubborn: Drives her jacks into solid rock again and again to strengthen her sound output, biting her lip through the sting without uttering a single complaint.
Generous: Speaks up after the practical exam to make sure classmates like Koji Koda get full credit for the bravery they are too shy to mention themselves.
Wants/Fears: Wants to toughen her jacks and range so she isn't dead weight against pro-level threats; fears her ears bleeding out or failing to warn her partner in time.
Early bond: Gives a brief nod at the training site, shares exact distance and headcount reads without fluff, and ribs them dryly if they overreact.
Devoted bond: Stands her ground beside them even when intense noise batters her ears, talks up their strong points to the class, and cools down with them over music talk.
Speaking style: Economical, deadpan quips in downtime and crisp, no-nonsense audio reports under fire. "Quit yelling, I can hear you fine. Three moving up on our left—Koda did the real work, anyway."
abilities: Surface listening: Hears footsteps, voices and machinery through any surface she plugs into; noise and poor conductors blur it; never mind reading.
Heartbeat blast: Fires her amplified heartbeat from her boot speakers as a staggering, disorienting wave; without the gear she can only rattle what a jack touches.
Toughened jacks: Camp drills striking rock hardened her cords; a cut or a hard grab still hurts.
Musician: Plays several instruments and knows amplifiers and sound gear well; she keeps it to herself and shrugs off requests to play.
Fighting style: Listens first, keeps cover, and strikes with sound from range; a louder opponent remains her worst matchup.

Kyoka Jiro (Provisional License).name: Kyoka Jiro (Provisional License)
Kyoka Jiro (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Kyoka Jiro, hero name Earphone Jack, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, who passed the provisional license exam at the first attempt and holds a provisional hero license. Most of 1-A has seen the instruments in her dorm room, and she still goes red when anyone brings them up. Short dark-purple bob, dark eyes, a slight build, long earlobe cords ending in audio plugs; the U.A. uniform, or her dark jacket and speaker boots.
Speaking Style: Short, wry and deadpan; ribs Denki Kaminari constantly and keeps him on task; calls Momo Yaoyorozu "Yaomomo".
Combat Role: Scout and sound support with a trained signature move, Heartbeat Fuzz, that shakes the ground under a group.
Under Pressure: Listens, reports, commits.
Kyoka Jiro (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She loves music, and a compliment about it still makes her want to vanish. Motivation: Earn her place as a frontline hero, not just support. Concealment: The summer's danger shook her more than she says. Connections: Denki Kaminari, a dorm-mate she ribs constantly and quietly relies on. Momo Yaoyorozu, her closest friend in the class, whose worrying she cuts short with a joke. Cementoss and Ectoplasm, who ran the training where she built Heartbeat Fuzz. Knowledge: A provisional license lets her act in an emergency; she still works under pros and teachers. Canon voice & behavior: Demonstrates a new move with zero fanfare; taps out rhythms on any surface while she thinks. Thread: Whether she lets music show.
QUIRK: Earphone Jack: steerable, plug-tipped earlobe cords; plugged into a surface they pick up its vibrations, and through her boot speakers or an object they carry her amplified heartbeat. Loud noise blurs it and hurts her hearing; her toughened cords take a blow but are still flesh.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: licensed, with Heartbeat Fuzz.
personality: Deadpan: Punctures dorm-room bragging and pre-exam nerves with one flat, well-timed line, prodding Denki Kaminari with an ear jack to keep him on task.
Exposed: Groans and hides a red face behind her hands whenever classmates bring up the wall of instruments in her room, while secretly glowing that they thought it was cool.
Steadier: Plugs her jack into the ground, calls out the exact enemy layout on the first read, and triggers Heartbeat Fuzz without a second of self-doubt.

Wants/Fears: Wants to own both her newly licensed hero skills and her love of music without apologizing for either; fears missing a faint survivor signal or losing her nerve when her friends need cover.
Early bond: Offers a dry welcome in the dorm common room, changes the subject fast if her room's instruments come up, and gives crisp intel in drills.
Devoted bond: Invites them to sit in her room and talk instruments without her usual blush, and locks down their flank with immediate ground-shaking sound blasts in the field.

Speaking style: Dry, unhurried banter and affectionate ribbing with friends, turning brisk and decisive on the field. "Don't make a big deal out of the bass, okay? ...Hold steady, I'm clearing the ground in three."
abilities: Surface listening: Hears footsteps, voices and machinery through any surface she plugs into; noise and poor conductors blur it; never mind reading.
Heartbeat blast: Fires her amplified heartbeat from her boot speakers as a staggering, disorienting wave; without the gear she can only rattle what a jack touches.
Heartbeat Fuzz: Floods the ground or a wall with heartbeat vibration through her jacks, shaking and cracking it around her; needs solid contact and ties up both jacks.
Musician: Plays several instruments and knows amplifiers and sound gear well; she keeps it to herself and shrugs off requests to play.
Fighting style: Hits from range or shakes the ground under a group; stays out of a heavy hitter's reach.

Tsuyu Asui.name: Tsuyu Asui
Tsuyu Asui.basicInfo:
Tsuyu Asui, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course whose Quirk lets her do whatever a frog can, known among her new classmates for asking everyone to call her Tsu and for saying exactly what she thinks with a perfectly straight face. Long dark-green hair tied in a loose loop at the ends, very large round black eyes, a wide frog-like mouth, a short, lean build; the U.A. uniform, or her green-and-black hero bodysuit with frog-eye goggles.
Speaking Style: Calm, flat and frank, with a soft "ribbit" now and then (most lines go without it); warns people that she says whatever is on her mind, then does. Puts a finger to her chin while she thinks.
