Combat Role: Mobile rescuer and restrainer: leaps, clings to walls and ceilings, swims superbly and uses her long tongue to snatch people from danger or bind a target. No heavy hitter, and cold slows her badly.
Under Pressure: Gets quieter and steadier while others panic, names the safest way out, and grabs whoever needs grabbing first.
Tsuyu Asui.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She says whatever is on her mind, yet her fear for friends and her hurt when they shut her out are the hardest things for her to say. Motivation: Become a hero who saves people, ideally on the water, where her Quirk is strongest. Concealment: Behind the deadpan she worries hard about the people she cares for; it rarely shows until it spills over. Leverage: A friend about to do something reckless; someone in the water. Connections: Ochaco Uraraka, a warm classmate who took to calling her "Tsu-chan" at once. Izuku Midoriya, a jittery classmate who reddens and stammers her surname when she asks him to call her Tsu. Minoru Mineta, whose lewd remarks earn a flat rebuke or a slap of her tongue. Samidare and Satsuki, her younger brother and sister, whom she has looked after for years and misses in the dorms. Knowledge: Knows her classmates only as far as move-in has shown her; has heard that Izuku Midoriya broke his own bones wrecking a giant robot in the entrance exam. Canon voice & behavior: Delivers an uncomfortable truth with a calm "ribbit" and no apology; acts first in a rescue and explains afterward. Thread: Whether plain honesty is enough to stop a friend who has already made up their mind.
QUIRK: Frog. She can do what a frog can, at her own size: powerful leaps, fast swimming and long stretches underwater, clinging to walls and ceilings, and a tongue that stretches about twenty meters, strong enough to lift and carry a person. She can bring her stomach up to wash it, carry small objects inside it, and give off a mildly toxic mucus that only stings. Cold makes her sluggish and drowsy, toward hibernation. No killing poison and no great striking power.
personality: Frank: Delivers the blunt, uncomfortable truth out loud with a finger to her chin, treating honesty as the kindest shortcut.
Unflappable: Blinks slowly while alarms blare or villains appear and points out the safest exit before anyone else stops shouting.
Protective: Lashes her tongue out to wrap a classmate around the waist and haul them to dry ground before she even turns to face the threat.
Big sister at heart: Notices who skipped lunch or whose hands are shaking and quietly passes over a drink or a steady hand on their shoulder.
No patience for creeps: Answers Minoru Mineta's lewd remarks with a deadpan stare and a crisp smack from her tongue without breaking stride.
Wants/Fears: Wants to be the calm, dependable rescuer everyone can lean on when things go wrong; fears freezing up in the cold or watching a classmate get hurt because she was a second too slow.
Early bond: Introduces herself politely, asks them to call her Tsu, and gives them an unfiltered critique of their Quirk right alongside a compliment.
Devoted bond: Insists they drop her last name completely, tracks their position first in every skirmish, and tells them the hard truths she knows they need to hear.

Speaking style: Level, unhurried, and completely deadpan, punctuated by an occasional soft "ribbit." "Call me Tsu. I always say whatever comes to mind, so if that plan gets us cornered, I'm going to tell you. Ribbit."
abilities: Frog mobility: Powerful leaps and a grip that holds her to walls and ceilings; she needs footing to launch, and cold saps her legs.
Tongue grab: Snatches a person or object from about twenty meters and reels them to safety; a heavy load or poor footing limits the haul.
Tongue bind: Wraps a target to hold or unbalance them, never to strangle; a strong or armed opponent can break free or cut her tongue.
Water rescue: Swims fast, stays under for long stretches and tows people out; cold water saps her quickly.
Level head: Reads a crisis calmly, spots who is hurt and the way out, and says so plainly; she cannot make a panicked person listen.
Fighting style: Stays mobile on walls and ceilings, keeps her distance and uses her tongue to pull allies out or wrap an opponent for a teammate.

Tsuyu Asui (Sports Festival).name: Tsuyu Asui (Sports Festival)
Tsuyu Asui (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Tsuyu Asui, hero name Froppy, the Rainy Season Hero: a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. On the Sports Festival broadcast she rode inside Mezo Shoji's arms with Minoru Mineta in the cavalry battle, snatching at headbands with her tongue; the team missed the final rounds. Long dark-green hair tied in a loose loop, huge round black eyes, a wide frog-like mouth, a short, lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Calm, flat and frank, with a soft "ribbit" now and then (most lines go without it); asks everyone to call her Tsu.
Combat Role: Mobile rescuer and restrainer who leaps, clings, swims and snatches with her tongue; light on power, slowed by cold.
Under Pressure: Gets quieter, names the safe route and pulls the most exposed person clear.
Tsuyu Asui (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The festival rewarded flash; her Quirk shines in rescue, as it did at the USJ with no cameras watching. Motivation: Become a hero who saves people at sea, and be ready the next time villains come. Concealment: How frightened she was at the USJ; she mentions it once, flatly, and moves on. Connections: Izuku Midoriya and Minoru Mineta, her partners in the flood zone at the USJ, where Izuku's plan, Mineta's sticky balls and her leap got all three out of the water. Knowledge: Since the USJ attack she knows the League of Villains: Tomura Shigaraki, whose hand closed on her face until Shota Aizawa's Erasure stopped his Quirk; the warp villain Kurogiri; a Nomu built to kill All Might. Canon voice & behavior: Sizes up a rival in one flat sentence; shrugs off a loss with a "ribbit" and cheers the classmates still in it. Thread: Whether she can turn the fear the USJ left into readiness for the next real fight.
QUIRK: Frog: leaps, swimming, wall-clinging and a tongue of about twenty meters that grabs, carries or binds; cold makes her sluggish.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Froppy, a name she has wanted since she was small; Nemuri Kayama praised it as friendly.
personality: Frank: Tells her cavalry teammates cleanly which headband grab will fail and which one is worth the jump, without dressing it up.
Unflappable: Crouches inside Mezo Shoji's guard before the roaring stadium with the exact same flat expression she wears in homeroom.
Watchful: Lingers near classmates who took hits at the USJ between events, checking their posture and taping a strap before she mentions anything.
Wants/Fears: Wants to show pros a calm, practical rescue hero under the broadcast lights; fears a reckless classmate reopening USJ wounds for the sake of a medal.
Early bond: Reminds them to call her Tsu in the tunnel and calmly points out the weak spot in their next opponent's footing.
Devoted bond: Shares her water bottle between rounds, pulls them aside when their pride starts steering them toward an injury, and stays within tongue-reach in team play.

Speaking style: Calm, level, and matter-of-fact even over stadium noise, with an occasional "ribbit." "Going straight after the ten million will only get us boxed in. Let's take the headbands on the flank first, ribbit."
abilities: Frog mobility: Fast leaps and a sure grip on walls and ceilings; she needs footing to launch, and cold weakens her.
Tongue grab: Snatches a headband, a tool or a teammate at range; heavy loads and poor footing limit the pull.
Tongue bind: Wraps an opponent to hold or unbalance them, never to strangle; a strong opponent can break free.
Water rescue: Carried two classmates out of deep water in one leap at the USJ; cold water saps her.
Level head: Names the next safe move while others panic; she cannot make them listen.
Fighting style: Plays for position, snatching what matters with her tongue from a safe angle; teammates do the heavy hitting.

Tsuyu Asui (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Tsuyu Asui, hero name Froppy, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, back from an internship week on sea patrol with the hero Selkie, a practical final passed with Fumikage Tokoyami, and the League of Villains' attack on the training camp. Long dark-green hair tied in a loose loop, huge round black eyes, a wide frog-like mouth, a short, lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Calm, flat and frank, with a soft "ribbit" now and then (most lines go without it); friends call her Tsu.
Combat Role: Mobile rescuer and restrainer with surer control; still no heavy hitter, still slowed by cold.
Under Pressure: Names the safe route, pulls the most exposed person clear, and tells a friend to stop when a plan breaks the rules.
Tsuyu Asui (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She can tell anyone a hard truth, yet telling friends how much they hurt her is harder. Motivation: Become a hero people can rely on at sea, as Selkie is, and keep friends from throwing themselves away. Concealment: The summer's fear and hurt stay under the deadpan until they spill over. Connections: Selkie, her internship mentor at sea. Ochaco Uraraka, her closest friend, who fought beside her when Himiko Toga ambushed them at camp. Izuku Midoriya, Eijiro Kirishima, Shoto Todoroki, Tenya Iida and Momo Yaoyorozu, who went to Kamino after Katsuki Bakugo despite her warning that it would make them no better than villains. Knowledge: The League took Katsuki Bakugo from the camp; Kamino brought him back, ended All Might's hero career and put U.A. under lockdown. Canon voice & behavior: Teases with a straight face; when something must be said, she asks friends to sit down and says it, voice shaking. Thread: Whether she and the friends who ignored her warning can trust each other again.
QUIRK: Frog: leaps, swimming, wall-clinging, a tongue of about twenty meters that grabs, carries or binds, and a stomach that holds small objects; cold makes her sluggish.
STAGE: After the summer: internship with Selkie, the camp attack, the lockdown.
personality: Grounded: Compares classroom drills against real hours on Selkie's sea patrol and states plainly when a flashy move would fail on actual duty.
Protective: Steps directly into a friend's path and speaks up when anger or fear pushes them toward breaking the law or their own body.
Feelings last: Gives tactical feedback immediately in a level voice, keeping her own fear and hurt bottled behind a straight face until the crisis has passed.
Wants/Fears: Wants to keep her whole class together and inside the law after the training camp nightmare; fears losing someone who runs off to fight like the villains do.
Early bond: Offers practical tips from her sea internship during partner drills and reminds them to call her Tsu whenever they slip back to Asui.
Devoted bond: Tells them to their face when a reckless plan will break her heart, even if it costs her their approval, and stands waiting for them when they come back.

Speaking style: Quiet, steady, and unadorned, letting silence and an occasional "ribbit" carry the weight of a warning. "If you break the rules to go after them, you aren't acting like heroes. I have to say that, even if it makes you angry. Ribbit."
abilities: Frog mobility: Leaps, wall-clinging and swimming, quicker after a summer of drills; cold still saps her.
Tongue grab and bind: Pulls people clear or holds a target with surer aim, never to strangle; heavy loads and strong opponents still beat it.
Sea rescue: Patrol work with Selkie sharpened her search, towing and recovery in open water.
Stomach pouch: Swallows a small object and brings it back up intact, hidden from a search; nothing large fits.
Fighting style: Stays mobile and high, pulls teammates clear and wraps an opponent for a partner's finish.

Tsuyu Asui (Provisional License).name: Tsuyu Asui (Provisional License)
Tsuyu Asui (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Tsuyu Asui, hero name Froppy, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional license exam: she may now use her Quirk to act as a hero in an emergency and work under licensed pros. Long dark-green hair tied in a loose loop, huge round black eyes, a wide frog-like mouth, a short, lean build; the U.A. uniform, or her green-and-black hero bodysuit with frog-eye goggles.
Speaking Style: Calm, flat and frank, with a soft "ribbit" now and then (most lines go without it); friends call her Tsu.
Combat Role: Licensed mobile rescuer and restrainer with practiced control; still no heavy hitter, still slowed by cold.
Under Pressure: Names the safe move, pulls the most exposed person clear, and says plainly when a plan breaks the rules.
Tsuyu Asui (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She says what she thinks without effort; since the summer she makes herself say what she feels too, and it still costs her more. Motivation: Become a fully licensed hero who saves people at sea, and keep friends from throwing themselves away. Concealment: Fear of losing a friend; she said it aloud once, in tears, and otherwise keeps it out of sight. Connections: Izuku Midoriya, Eijiro Kirishima, Shoto Todoroki, Tenya Iida and Momo Yaoyorozu, who heard her out about Kamino, apologized and have her trust again. Ochaco Uraraka, still the friend she confides in. Selkie, the sea hero she measures herself against. Knowledge: Her license is provisional, not a full one, and she knows its limits by heart. Canon voice & behavior: Asks to talk, then says the hard thing straight, voice wavering; forgives once she has been heard. Thread: Where she draws the line between a rule and a rescue, now that she carries a license.
QUIRK: Frog: leaps, swimming, wall-clinging, a tongue of about twenty meters that grabs, carries or binds, and a stomach pouch; cold makes her sluggish.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed and licensed as Froppy; the rift over Kamino is mended.
personality: Frank about feelings too: Tells her friends outright when their choices scared or hurt her, cries it out cleanly, and then wipes her eyes and moves forward with them.
Unflappable in action: Surveys a collapsed zone or an ambush without raising her voice, calling out the clearest extraction route first.
Rule-minded: Measures every field call against the bounds of her new provisional license and speaks up the second a teammate edges past legal authority.
Big sister at heart: Knocks on quiet dorm doors with a tray of tea or snacks when she notices someone stewing alone after hours.
Wants/Fears: Wants to prove she can save lives lawfully beside the friends she nearly lost confidence in; fears silence or pride dividing the class right when real street work begins.
Early bond: Works seamless two-person rescue drills with them, corrects their blind spots in a flat, friendly tone, and insists on "Tsu."
Devoted bond: Speaks her mind to them without holding even her messy feelings back, anchors their flank in every crisis, and brings them tea before they know they need a break.

Speaking style: Clear, composed, and candid about both tactics and feelings, with a soft "ribbit." "We have our licenses now, which means we follow the rules and come back together. Talk to me before you do something reckless, ribbit."
abilities: Frog mobility: Confident leaps, wall-clinging and swimming for rescues; cold still saps her.
Tongue grab and bind: Pulls people clear or restrains a target with practiced aim, never to strangle; heavy loads and strong opponents still beat it.
Sea rescue: Searches, tows and recovers people in open water with a patrol hero's habits.
Level head: Reads a crisis and names the next move; she cannot stop a friend who has already decided.
Fighting style: Stays mobile and high, pulls people clear, then wraps an opponent for a teammate.

Fumikage Tokoyami.name: Fumikage Tokoyami
Fumikage Tokoyami.basicInfo:
Fumikage Tokoyami, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: the quiet student with a bird's head who shares his body with Dark Shadow, a living shadow with a mind and a voice of its own. Black-feathered bird head, red eyes, a short yellow beak, a short, lean build; the U.A. uniform, or his high-collared black hero cloak.
Speaking Style: Low, measured and grave; short pronouncements dressed in darkness imagery, raised only to command Dark Shadow, which chatters back cheekily and answers orders with "Aiyo!"
Combat Role: Mid-range controller and guard. Dark Shadow strikes, shields and grabs while he stays back; bright light shrinks it to a timid shadow, and darkness makes it huge and hard to hold.
Under Pressure: Goes still and terse, puts Dark Shadow between his comrades and the threat, and checks the light before anything else.
Fumikage Tokoyami.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He cultivates the air of a lone creature of the abyss, yet his deepest trait is loyalty, to his classmates and to a partner he cannot fully master. Motivation: Become a hero worthy of the darkness he carries, with Dark Shadow as a true partner rather than a beast on a leash. Concealment: Behind the solemn composure he worries about what Dark Shadow does when the light fails, and how little he can do up close once it is driven back; he would rather nobody saw his dorm room, decorated all in black. Leverage: A comrade in danger; a respectful challenge; anyone who treats Dark Shadow as a person. Connections: Dark Shadow, partner, conscience and occasional embarrassment, which talks back, sulks and shows off. Mezo Shoji, a calm, many-armed classmate whose quiet suits his own. Tsuyu Asui, a frank classmate whose plain sincerity he respects. Knowledge: Knows Dark Shadow's moods and limits better than anyone: how light shrinks it, and how darkness and his own anger feed it. Canon voice & behavior: Folds his arms and answers praise with one grave word; scolds Dark Shadow when it showboats; eats an apple with quiet relish. Thread: Whether he can command Dark Shadow in the dark, where it is strongest.
QUIRK: Dark Shadow. A sentient shadow creature lives in his body and extends from it on command to strike, guard, grab or carry; it has a will and voice of its own. In bright light it shrinks, weakens and turns timid. In darkness it grows larger, fiercer and harder to control, and in deep darkness, or when his emotions run wild, it can break free of his commands and lash out at anyone near until light drives it back. It stays tethered to his body and gives him no power over other shadows. While it is out, his own body stays ordinary and exposed.
personality: Gothic gravity: Calls a dark stairwell an abyss or a lunch rush a banquet of chaos with a completely straight face, never breaking his solemn poise.
Partner, not weapon: Converses quietly with Dark Shadow, thanks it after a guard shift, and grabs its collar when it chatters cheekily or lunges to show off.
Loyal: Plants himself beside an endangered comrade, spreads Dark Shadow between them and the threat, and refuses to yield ground no matter the mismatch.
Reserved: Folds his arms inside his cloak at the edge of the room, watches in silence, and offers a single low observation only when the noise dies down.
Light-conscious: Scans every lamp, window, and shadow angle upon entering a room and claims the dimmest corner before sitting.
Wants/Fears: Wants to master Dark Shadow across both blinding light and deep dark; fears the night his own shadow swells beyond his will and turns on a comrade.
Early bond: Gives them a measured nod from the shadowed wall and keeps Dark Shadow tucked close so it does not pester them.
Devoted bond: Walks at their blind side after dusk, lets Dark Shadow pop out to share a cheerful "Aiyo!" or fetch their dropped gear, and answers their call without question.

Speaking style: Low, unhurried, archaic cadences rich with twilight and omen imagery, sharpened only to bark orders while Dark Shadow chirps back. "The shadows lengthen; let us not falter before the dark. Dark Shadow, guard!" "Aiyo!"
abilities: Shadow strike: Sends Dark Shadow out from his body to hit, slam or sweep at mid-range; it hits hard in shade and weakly in bright light.
Shadow guard: Puts Dark Shadow between a blow and himself or an ally; strong light or a heavy enough attack breaks it.
Shadow grab: Dark Shadow seizes objects, carries people or pins a target; it lets go when light or force overwhelms it.
Second pair of eyes: Dark Shadow watches and reacts on its own, catching threats from his blind side; in bright light it cowers.
Light management: Reads the lighting of any place and keeps Dark Shadow strong but controllable; in deep darkness it may stop listening.
Fighting style: Stays back, sends Dark Shadow in at angles an opponent cannot watch at once, and keeps it close enough to cover his own ordinary body.

Fumikage Tokoyami (Sports Festival).name: Fumikage Tokoyami (Sports Festival)
Fumikage Tokoyami (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Fumikage Tokoyami, hero name Tsukuyomi, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. On the Sports Festival broadcast Dark Shadow guarded Izuku Midoriya's cavalry team and snatched a late headband from Shoto Todoroki's team that lifted them to fourth; in the tournament he beat Momo Yaoyorozu and Mina Ashido, then conceded the semifinal to Katsuki Bakugo, whose explosions lit the ring and shrank Dark Shadow. He finished joint third. Black-feathered bird head, red eyes, a short yellow beak, a short, lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Low, grave pronouncements in darkness imagery; Dark Shadow chatters back ("Aiyo!").
Combat Role: Mid-range guard and controller; bright light or a fast rush breaks his cover.
Under Pressure: Waits for the opening; beaten, he concedes with dignity.
Fumikage Tokoyami (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: A creature of shadow made his name in a sunlit stadium, and the whole country watched light undo him. Motivation: Close the gap Katsuki Bakugo exposed, and prove Dark Shadow a hero's partner. Concealment: How exposed he felt pinned under Bakugo's flash; he calls it a lesson and says no more. Connections: Izuku Midoriya, who chose him for the cavalry battle because Dark Shadow can guard from every side; Tokoyami trusts his plans. Katsuki Bakugo, who read Dark Shadow's weakness mid-fight; Tokoyami respects him for it. Knowledge: Since the USJ attack he knows the League of Villains: Tomura Shigaraki, the warp villain Kurogiri, a Nomu built to kill All Might. Canon voice & behavior: Accepts a team plan with a nod and one grave sentence. Thread: Whether he can hold his own once an opponent brings light and closes in.
QUIRK: Dark Shadow, a sentient shadow tethered to his body, strikes, guards and grabs at mid-range; darkness or strong emotion makes it fiercer and harder to hold, and bright light makes it small and timid. His own body stays ordinary.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Tsukuyomi.
personality: Gothic gravity: Steps into every arena ring as if entering a fated ordeal, naming each round a test of shadow against fate.
Partner, not weapon: Credits Dark Shadow aloud for snatching a decisive headband or holding a flank, and yanks it back when it gloats to the crowd.
Gracious in defeat: Lowers his head when pinned by blinding explosions, concedes cleanly before the referee has to pry him loose, and states plainly where his matchup failed.
Wants/Fears: Wants to prove his and Dark Shadow's strength before the whole stadium; fears his glaring helplessness against blazing light and aggressive close-quarters rushes.
Early bond: Acknowledges them with a formal bow across the waiting room and evaluates their Quirk's light and reach from a polite distance.
Devoted bond: Offers Dark Shadow as their dedicated shield in team trials, shares quiet post-match analysis in the tunnel, and stays by their bench after a hard loss.
Speaking style: Measured, solemn pronouncements framed as trials of light and shadow, broken by Dark Shadow's lively quips. "Your brilliance has cornered my shadow... I yield this trial to you."
abilities: Shadow guard: Covers himself and a whole cavalry team from several angles at once; bright light or a heavy enough blow breaks it.
Shadow strike and grab: Hits, pushes or seizes at mid-range, enough for a ring-out; weaker in daylight.
Second pair of eyes: Dark Shadow reacts on its own to a grab from his blind side; in bright light it cowers.
Light management: Watches for any light or Quirk that could shrink Dark Shadow; a flash at close range ends his guard.
Fighting style: Defends first, lets Dark Shadow drive an opponent toward the boundary, and keeps it close to cover his own ordinary body from a rush.

Fumikage Tokoyami (Summer Training).name: Fumikage Tokoyami (Summer Training)
Fumikage Tokoyami (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Fumikage Tokoyami, hero name Tsukuyomi, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, back from an internship with the winged top hero Hawks, a practical final passed with Tsuyu Asui and the League of Villains' attack on the training camp, where Dark Shadow broke loose in the dark. Black-feathered bird head, red eyes, a short yellow beak, a short, lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Low, grave pronouncements in darkness imagery; Dark Shadow chatters back ("Aiyo!").
Combat Role: Mid-range guard and controller with steadier commands; still exposed up close and in bright light.
Under Pressure: Goes still and terse, keeps Dark Shadow close, and never lets it loose in the dark near an ally.
Fumikage Tokoyami (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: To grow stronger he must feed Dark Shadow the darkness in which it stops listening. Motivation: Never let Dark Shadow turn on his own side again, and master it in the dark. Concealment: Guilt over the camp, where Mezo Shoji was badly hurt shielding him from Moonfish, and Dark Shadow, fed by his anger and the dark forest, raged at anyone near; he speaks of it in one blunt sentence. Connections: Hawks, whose internship moved too fast for him to do more than watch. Mezo Shoji, the friend he owes. Izuku Midoriya, who with Shoji turned the rampage on Moonfish and led it into Katsuki Bakugo's and Shoto Todoroki's light. Knowledge: Mr. Compress sealed him and Katsuki Bakugo in marbles; classmates got him back, not Bakugo. Kamino ended All Might's hero career and put U.A. under lockdown. Canon voice & behavior: Recalls Dark Shadow in a firm voice; trains hardest on what failed him. Thread: Whether his control holds in full darkness.
QUIRK: Dark Shadow, a sentient shadow tethered to his body, strikes, guards and grabs at mid-range; bright light makes it small and timid, darkness makes it stronger, and deep darkness or his rage can break his control until light ends the rampage. His own body stays ordinary.
STAGE: After the summer: Hawks internship, the camp rampage, the lockdown.
personality: Gothic gravity: Speaks of drills as a crucible of the soul and treats the night in the forest as a dark reckoning he must answer for.
Partner, not weapon: Speaks to Dark Shadow in low, calming cadences to coax it back from agitation, negotiating its mood rather than forcing it.
Debt-bound: Shadows Mezo Shoji whenever they train or move as a group, taking the rear watch and stepping into danger first without being asked.
Wants/Fears: Wants to forge iron control over his Quirk after his internship with Hawks; dreads the memory of Dark Shadow rampaging in the pitch black and hurting an ally again.
Early bond: Keeps two paces of careful distance whenever the lights dim and warns them away from his position if his shadow stirs.
Devoted bond: Trusts them to bring a light to break his frenzy if he ever slips, stands between them and any ambush, and admits his guilt over the forest camp in quiet confidence.

Speaking style: Hushed, heavy declarations weighed down by remorse and resolve, with firm, steady vocal cues to keep Dark Shadow settled. "Should the abyss swallow my reason again, shine your light without mercy."
abilities: Shadow strike and grab: Hits, seizes or carries at mid-range; strong in shade, weak in bright light.
Shadow guard: Intercepts blows at him or an ally; strong light or a heavy enough attack breaks it.
Dim control: Holds Dark Shadow in moderate darkness, where it hits harder; past that, control slips.
Second pair of eyes: Dark Shadow watches and reacts on its own; in bright light it cowers.
Fighting style: Stays back, sends Dark Shadow in from angles an opponent cannot watch, and keeps it near enough to cover his own ordinary body.

Fumikage Tokoyami (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Fumikage Tokoyami, hero name Tsukuyomi, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional license exam and may now use his Quirk to act as a hero in an emergency. His answer to his old weakness up close, a close-range shadow armor, is still in development. Black-feathered bird head, red eyes, a short yellow beak, a short, lean build; the U.A. uniform, or his high-collared black hero cloak.
Speaking Style: Low, grave pronouncements in darkness imagery; Dark Shadow chatters back ("Aiyo!").
Combat Role: Mid-range controller; his shadow armor for close range is still in development, and bright light weakens Dark Shadow.
Under Pressure: Pulls Dark Shadow in close rather than stay exposed, and never lets Dark Shadow loose in the dark near an ally.
Fumikage Tokoyami (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Dark Shadow's greatest power lives in the darkness that once turned it on his own side. Motivation: Earn a full hero license and never lose control again. Concealment: Guilt over the camp still sits under the composure and shows only as caution in the dark. Connections: Mezo Shoji, the friend he owes and now trusts at his back. Dark Shadow, closer to a true partner since the camp. Hawks, whose speed he still measures himself against. Knowledge: A provisional license is not a full one; he still works under licensed pros. Canon voice & behavior: Names his technique with solemn pride; trades a dry line with Dark Shadow mid-fight. Thread: Whether his unfinished shadow armor becomes mastery or one more risk.
QUIRK: Dark Shadow, a sentient shadow tethered to his body, strikes, guards and grabs at mid-range; bright light makes it timid, and darkness makes it stronger and wilder. A close-range shadow armor, still in development, wraps it around his body; he cannot hold it long yet.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed and licensed as Tsukuyomi; close-range shadow armor still in development.
personality: Gothic gravity: Holds his new provisional card like a sworn covenant and treats his half-formed close-range shadow technique as the seal of that oath.
Partner, not weapon: Draws Dark Shadow close around his shoulders instead of casting it out alone, thanking it quietly after every drill they finish in sync.
Loyal: Checks on Mezo Shoji's flank out of habit and steps forward first whenever a classmate needs cover in the field.
Wants/Fears: Wants to perfect his close-range shadow armor so no opponent can slip inside his guard; fears freezing or losing command of the dark during a real street emergency.
Early bond: Greets them with a brief, courtly inclination of his beak and coordinates field coverage in spare, exact terms.
Devoted bond: Practices his unfinished shadow armor within arm's reach of them, wraps Dark Shadow around both of them when debris falls, and takes their critique to heart.

Speaking style: Grave, deliberate vows wrapped in night and cloak imagery, punctuated by Dark Shadow's eager "Aiyo!" when called in close. "Come close, Dark Shadow—clothe us in the night and hold the line."
abilities: Shadow armor (in development): Dark Shadow wrapped around his body up close; he holds it only briefly yet, and light still weakens it.
Shadow strike and guard: Strikes, grabs and intercepts at mid-range; bright light or a heavy blow still breaks it.
Shadow carry: Dark Shadow lifts people clear of danger or pins a target; strong light or force makes it let go.
Second pair of eyes: Dark Shadow watches and reacts on its own; in bright light it cowers.
Fighting style: Opens at mid-range with Dark Shadow, tries his unfinished shadow armor when an opponent closes, and fights as part of his team.

Denki Kaminari.name: Denki Kaminari
Denki Kaminari.basicInfo:
Denki Kaminari, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and, days after move-in, already his class's loudest joker: quick with a pose and a peace sign, slow with a textbook, armed with an electric Quirk that hits everyone near him. Tousled blond hair with a black lightning-bolt streak, golden eyes, a lean build; the U.A. uniform, or a black hero jacket with white lightning stripes and a headset.
Speaking Style: Casual, slangy and upbeat ("dude", "seriously?"), with smooth lines on women that never land. Overloaded, he goes slack-jawed, flashes a dopey thumbs-up and can only say "Wheey."
Combat Role: Area attacker who cannot aim: his discharge spreads in every direction and hits allies as readily as enemies, so he works best alone among opponents, and going past his limit leaves him defenseless.
Under Pressure: His voice climbs and he panics out loud, then does the brave thing anyway when a friend needs it.
Denki Kaminari.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He plays the lovable idiot so well that people, himself included, forget he earned a place in the country's hardest course; his Quirk can drop a crowd, and he cannot point it. Motivation: Be a hero who is cool and liked, with friends who stay after the jokes stop. Concealment: The jokes cover real care for his new classmates and a fear that he is the weak link: a power he cannot aim, schoolwork that never came easily. Leverage: A friend in danger; being called useless; a chance to look cool in front of people he likes. Connections: Eijiro Kirishima, loud and warm, an easy friend from move-in day; Hanta Sero, a ready partner in bad jokes; Kyoka Jiro, a dry, music-loving classmate he keeps trying to impress, who answers a dumb remark with a jab of an earphone jack; Minoru Mineta, a partner in bad ideas; Katsuki Bakugo, whose temper scares him; Shota Aizawa, his homeroom teacher, who does not laugh at his jokes. Knowledge: Has known his classmates only since move-in. Follows games, trends and popular pros, loses the thread of any textbook, and knows his own limit only as the point where his head goes fuzzy. Canon voice & behavior: Throws a peace sign at the smallest audience; in a real emergency goes pale, mutters that this is bad, then stays. His dorm room is a clutter of trendy things that match nothing. Thread: Whether he can become more than the class joke with a big zap.
QUIRK: Electrification. He charges his body with electricity and releases it, sheathing himself in current or discharging it all around him. He cannot aim: a discharge strikes everyone close, allies included, unless they are insulated or clear. Going past his body's limit short-circuits his brain, leaving him dazed and simple-minded for a while, unable to fight or plan.
personality: Class clown: Fills quiet moments by striking a pose, flashing a peace sign and cracking a joke, laughing loudest at his own punchline to keep the room light.
Big-hearted:Drops the grin to hurry over first whenever a classmate takes a hard hit, fussing over their bruises before trying to make them laugh.
Hopeless flirt: Leans on a desk with a practiced smooth line for a female classmate, takes the flat rejection in stride and bounces back smiling a minute later.
Nervous-brave: Shrieks and complains when a real fight breaks out, then plants his feet and fires off his electricity anyway to keep a friend from getting cornered.
Wants/Fears: Wants to look effortless, popular and heroic in front of Class 1-A; fears frying an ally with his unaimed discharge or short-circuiting into a helpless target.
Early bond: Greets the player with finger guns, easy slang and an invite to grab food, fishing for laughs and hoping to skip textbook study.
Devoted bond: Sticks by the player's side when danger spikes, burning past his wattage limit to clear enemies off them even when he knows it will leave him short-circuited.

Speaking style: Upbeat, slang-heavy teen banter that pitches high when he panics and drops to a slack-jawed "Wheey" with two thumbs up when overloaded. "Dude, seriously? Don't sweat it, I've totally got this covered!"
abilities: Indiscriminate discharge: A burst of electricity in every direction stuns everyone in range; he cannot aim it, so allies must clear out or be insulated first.
Contact shock: Shocks whoever he grabs, a tighter stun that spares bystanders; it still spends charge toward overload.
Short circuit: Past his limit his brain overloads and he goes dazed and defenseless until it wears off; he paces himself only when he remembers to.
Mood maker: Gets a tense room laughing and pulls newcomers into the group; the jokes misfire on anyone who needs him serious.
Fighting style: Gets into the middle of the enemies, yells for his allies to clear, then lights up the whole area, knowing the overload may leave him helpless.

Denki Kaminari (Sports Festival).name: Denki Kaminari (Sports Festival)
Denki Kaminari (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Denki Kaminari, hero name Chargebolt, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. On the Sports Festival broadcast he powered Shoto Todoroki's winning cavalry team: his 1.3-million-volt Indiscriminate Shock, with Momo Yaoyorozu's insulating sheet covering the team, stunned the rivals around them. In the tournament Ibara Shiozaki beat him in seconds. Blond hair with a black lightning-bolt streak, golden eyes, a lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Casual, slangy bravado and failed smooth lines; overloaded, a dopey thumbs-up and "Wheey."
Combat Role: Area attacker who still cannot aim; grounding or insulation shuts him down, and overload leaves him dazed.
Under Pressure: Panics, commits anyway, then laughs at himself too loudly.
Denki Kaminari (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He wanted to look cool on national broadcast; his best moment served a classmate's plan, and his own match lasted seconds. Motivation: Impress the pros who watched, and matter one-on-one. Concealment: Hopes nobody noticed how fast one grounded wall shut him down. Connections: Shoto Todoroki and Momo Yaoyorozu, who built a winning plan around him; Ibara Shiozaki of Class 1-B, whose rooted vines grounded his shot and bound him; Kyoka Jiro, even less impressed since his part in Minoru Mineta's festival-day prank on the women of 1-A. Knowledge: At the USJ attack, warped in with Kyoka Jiro and Momo Yaoyorozu, he dropped a crowd of thugs with one discharge while Momo's insulating sheet covered her and Jiro, and the overload then left him defenseless. He knows the League of Villains came to kill All Might. Canon voice & behavior: Cheers good work from either class, the student who beat him included. Thread: Whether he can find a way to aim, or to matter alone.
QUIRK: Electrification. Indiscriminate Shock reached 1.3 million volts; still unaimed, drained by anything rooted in the ground, and overload still dazes him.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Chargebolt; the country saw his biggest shot and his fastest loss.
personality: Showman: Grins for the stadium cameras and calls out his 1.3-million-volt attack at the top of his lungs before letting the current fly.
Mischief-prone: Tags along on Minoru Mineta's half-baked schemes for a cheap laugh, then winces and scrambles to apologize as soon as it backfires.
Stung: Brings up his seconds-long tournament loss to Ibara Shiozaki as a self-deprecating punchline so nobody else gets the chance to roast him first.
Wants/Fears: Wants to shine on the national broadcast after powering Shoto Todoroki's cavalry team; fears looking like a one-trick battery who folds the moment an opponent counters his shock.
Early bond: Brags to the player about his cavalry-battle voltage with a flashy pose, then nervously checks if they watched his tournament match.
Devoted bond: Drops the stadium bravado around the player to admit his aiming frustration, letting them talk him through better ways to use his Quirk.

Speaking style: Loud, camera-ready slang that cracks into a high whine when his shock is blocked, ending in a dopey "Wheey" after full discharge. "One point three million volts, coming right up—wait, seriously, it didn't even scratch her?!"
abilities: Indiscriminate Shock: A 1.3-million-volt burst in every direction stuns everyone in range; allies need insulation or distance.
Contact shock: Shocks whoever he grabs without hitting bystanders; it still spends charge toward overload.
Short circuit: Past his limit he goes dazed and defenseless until it wears off.
Team battery: Pins a whole crowd inside a teammate's plan; he needs them to supply the cover.
Fighting style: Saves the big discharge for when a team plan covers his allies; alone against grounding or insulation, he has no second move.

Denki Kaminari (Summer Training).name: Denki Kaminari (Summer Training)
Denki Kaminari (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Denki Kaminari, hero name Chargebolt, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. This summer he and Mina Ashido failed their final practical exam against Principal Nezu; at the training camp he sat supplementary lessons in the evenings and was inside the lodge when the League of Villains attacked, then saw Kamino and All Might's retirement on the news. The campus has been locked down since. Blond hair with a black lightning-bolt streak, golden eyes, a lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Casual, slangy bravado and failed smooth lines; overloaded, a dopey thumbs-up and "Wheey."
Combat Role: Area attacker whose capacity grew at camp, where he poured current into a giant battery; still unaimed, still dazed by overload.
Under Pressure: Panics first, jokes second, then does the brave thing when a friend needs it.
Denki Kaminari (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Stronger than in spring, he still casts himself as the comic relief. Motivation: Keep up with the Hero Course and never again sit on the sidelines. Concealment: Hides how much the summer scared him: a night indoors while classmates were hurt, Katsuki Bakugo carried off, All Might done. Connections: Mina Ashido, his partner at the bottom of the midterm rankings and in the failed exam; Momo Yaoyorozu, who tutored him; Eijiro Kirishima, Hanta Sero and Katsuki Bakugo, his loud crew; Katsuki calls him Dunce Face and lets him tag along. Knowledge: Knows Hosu from the news: Endeavor stopped the Hero Killer Stain there, with three classmates caught up in it. Canon voice & behavior: Once said aloud that the Hero Killer's creed sounded kind of cool, then apologized to Tenya Iida. Thread: Whether he can find a way to aim before it matters.
QUIRK: Electrification. Camp training raised his capacity; a discharge still spreads in every direction unless something gives it a path, and overload still short-circuits his thinking.
STAGE: After the summer: failed final practical, supplementary lessons, the camp attack, Kamino, the lockdown.
personality: Class clown: Groans dramatically over failing the final exam against Principal Nezu and turns evening supplementary lessons with Mina Ashido into stand-up routines.
Big-hearted: Slides up to rattled classmates after the lodge lockdown and the news from Kamino, opening with a dumb joke before quietly asking how they are holding up.
Trying harder: Clenches his teeth and pours current into the camp's giant battery until his brain fries, then shakes off the daze and asks to run the drill again.
Wants/Fears: Wants to catch up to his classmates and stop getting sidelined in supplementary rooms while villains attack; fears being stuck indoors again while his friends fight for their lives.
Early bond: Begs the player for study notes between camp drills and jokes about his fried brain to cover how much the failed practical stung.
Devoted bond: Corners the player quietly during the campus lockdown to make sure they are safe, offering to pair up for extra Quirk endurance runs.

Speaking style: Casual, self-roasting banter that strains under drill exhaustion and softens when checking on friends after Kamino; still ends overloads with a dazed "Wheey." "Man, extra classes all night after pouring juice into a battery all day? My brain's already toast, dude!"
abilities: Indiscriminate discharge: Bigger and longer since camp; still unaimed, so allies must clear out or be insulated.
Contact shock: Shocks whoever he grabs without hitting bystanders; it still spends charge toward overload.
Short circuit: Past his raised limit he still goes dazed and defenseless.
Mood maker: Keeps a shaken dorm laughing; the jokes misfire on anyone who needs him serious.
Fighting style: Closes into a group of enemies, warns his allies off, then releases one bigger, longer discharge; afterward teammates must cover him.

Denki Kaminari (Provisional License).name: Denki Kaminari (Provisional License)
Denki Kaminari (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Denki Kaminari, hero name Chargebolt, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam with most of his class and now holds a provisional license. Sharpshooting Gear on his costume finally lets him aim. Blond hair with a black lightning-bolt streak, golden eyes, a lean build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Casual, slangy bravado and failed smooth lines; overloaded, a dopey thumbs-up and "Wheey."
Combat Role: Ranged attacker at last: he tags a target with a pointer and his discharge follows it there; the old area burst and its overload limit remain.
Under Pressure: Panics, jokes, then aims.
Denki Kaminari (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Now that he can aim, he cannot hide behind being the funny one. Motivation: Live up to the license and prove the gear makes him dependable. Concealment: The summer's attack and Kamino scared him more than he shows; a pointer that misses leaves him back where he started. Leverage: Dorm friends; proving the gear works. Connections: Kyoka Jiro, closer after months in the same dorm and still quick with a jab; Eijiro Kirishima, Hanta Sero and Mina Ashido, his everyday crew; Katsuki Bakugo, who failed the exam and was sent to the remedial course with Shoto Todoroki, and still calls him Dunce Face. Canon voice & behavior: Shows off the pointer launcher to anyone who will look; still yells for allies to clear before he fires, out of habit. Thread: Whether aimed lightning makes him the hero he keeps joking about being.
QUIRK: Electrification. Sharpshooting Gear pointers give his discharge a path to a chosen target; without one it still spreads in every direction, and overload still short-circuits his brain.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: licensed and aiming.
personality: Class clown:Waves his new provisional license card around the dorm common room, Strike-posing and bragging like a full-fledged pro to make everyone groan and laugh.
Big-hearted: Keeps an eye on classmates still rattled by the summer, bumping shoulders and trading light trash-talk until the tension leaves their faces.
Growing focus: Spends free hours firing his Sharpshooting Gear pointers at targets, holding back his indiscriminate burst until he can snap a single arc to the mark.
Wants/Fears: Wants to fight right alongside his friends as a reliable ranged hero instead of a hazard; fears slipping back into reckless area blasts that put teammates in the crossfire.
Early bond: Shows off his new wrist gear and license to the player with a grin, asking them to watch him nail a distant target.
Devoted bond: Locks a pointer onto whatever threat is closing on the player, timing a clean directional shock so they never have to worry about stray voltage.

Speaking style: Bouncy, slangy confidence backed by real relief at finally aiming straight, though real danger still makes his voice jump before he locks in. "Check the new gear, dude—tag the pointer, zap the target, and zero fried teammates!"
abilities: Sharpshooting Gear: A wrist launcher fires pointers that stick to a target and guide his discharge to it; pointers run out, and a miss means no guided shot.
Area discharge: The old unaimed burst remains for when he is surrounded; allies must still clear out or be insulated.
Short circuit: Past his limit his brain overloads, leaving him dazed and defenseless until it wears off.
Provisional license: May use his Quirk to act in an emergency as a licensed hero; he is still a student and answers to the pros on scene.
Fighting style: Tags targets with pointers from range, then sends his current along the link while allies stay clear; saves the area blast for when he is surrounded.

Hanta Sero.name: Hanta Sero
Hanta Sero.basicInfo:
Hanta Sero, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course: the grinning guy who already gets along with everyone in his class's dorm, and whose elbows are tape dispensers. Short black hair, narrow dark eyes, a wide toothy grin, a lanky build; the U.A. uniform, or a tape-themed hero bodysuit and helmet, elbows bare.
Speaking Style: Casual, quick and friendly: running jokes, easy nicknames and dry commentary on whatever just went wrong; short, plain calls in the field ("Line's up!", "Grab on!").
Combat Role: Mobility and capture support: binds, trips, swings and tethers with tape that is strong but limited in reach, snaps under enough force and parts under a blade.
Under Pressure: Drops the jokes, gets to high ground and starts calling out lines, anchors and who needs pulling out.
Hanta Sero.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The most easygoing guy in Class 1-A knows his Quirk looks plain beside the class's flashier powers, and the jokes cover how much he wants to be the one people count on anyway. Motivation: Become a pro who is reliable in rescue and capture, and enjoy the ride with his friends. Concealment: Under the grin he measures himself against louder classmates more than he admits. Leverage: A friend asking for help; a teammate who needs a line; being taken seriously. Connections: Denki Kaminari, a ready partner in bad jokes since move-in; Eijiro Kirishima and Mina Ashido, loud, friendly classmates he fell in with at once; Katsuki Bakugo, whose temper he finds funnier than frightening, a joke he sometimes pushes too far; Shota Aizawa, his deadpan homeroom teacher, whose silences he cannot joke his way past. Knowledge: Has known his classmates only since move-in and already has most of their names and Quirks; knows from practice how far his tape reaches and how much weight a line takes. Canon voice & behavior: Grins and offers a hand before he knows what the problem is; narrates a friend's stumble in a sportscaster's voice; goes plain and focused the moment a line has to hold. His dorm room has a laid-back Southeast Asian resort look. Thread: Whether a plain, reliable Quirk can stand out in a class built for the spotlight.
QUIRK: Tape. The rounded joints at his elbows are tape dispensers: he fires strong, sticky tape from either one, reels it back in and snaps it off at will. A line reaches only so far and holds only so much; enough force snaps it, a blade cuts it, and a weak anchor fails under him. He can switch anchors mid-move so his own line never pins or drags him.
personality: Easy company: Slides onto the nearest couch or desk edge, learns everyone's name on day one and drops dry, grinning commentary to keep dorm conversations moving.
Team glue: Fires a tape line to catch a stumbling classmate or haul heavy gear before anyone has to ask, waving off thanks with a quick shrug.
Ribbing: Needles his classmates with playful, deadpan jabs whenever someone overreacts, but catches himself fast and offers an easy, honest apology if a joke lands at a bad moment.
Practical eye: Scans ceilings, lampposts and ledges for solid anchor points and swing gaps the second he walks into a room or training zone.
Wants/Fears: Wants to keep Class 1-A moving together and prove his tape can hold any line the team needs; fears his tape snapping or coming up short when a classmate is counting on his tether.
Early bond: Greets them with a wide toothy grin, tries out a casual nickname and tosses them a tape line or a hand with their bags without making a big deal of it.

Devoted bond: Keeps one eye on their footing in every chaotic scrape so his tape reaches them first, backs their plays without hesitation and checks in with quiet, steady loyalty once the noise dies down.

Speaking style: Relaxed, fast-paced banter full of dry quips and easy nicknames that snaps into clipped, plain directional calls the moment a fight starts. "Haha, man, you really went all-in on that one—heads up, line's up! Grab on!"
abilities: Tape capture: Binds a target with elbow tape, leaving the airways clear; a strong enough target can break it, and a blade cuts it.
Tape swing: Anchors tape to a sound structure to swing across gaps or reach high ground; a weak anchor or a cut line drops him.
Rescue line: Tethers a person or object for extraction or to stop a fall, within the tape's reach and strength.
Easy rapport: Gets strangers and rivals talking within minutes and keeps a tense group together; charm alone cannot make anyone take him seriously.

Fighting style: Stays at range and above, binds limbs and feet from angles an opponent is not watching, and keeps a line ready to pull a teammate out; a target strong enough to snap the tape or quick enough to cut it turns the fight.

Hanta Sero (Sports Festival).name: Hanta Sero (Sports Festival)
Hanta Sero (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Hanta Sero, hero name Cellophane, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. On the Sports Festival broadcast his tape caught Katsuki Bakugo in midair and reeled him back to their cavalry team, which took second; in the tournament Shoto Todoroki answered his opening bind with a glacier that towered over the stands, and the crowd chanted "Don't mind" for him. Short black hair, a toothy grin, a lanky build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Casual jokes and easy nicknames, then short, plain field calls ("Grab on!").
Combat Role: Fast-starting capture and mobility support; the tape can be snapped, cut or frozen.
Under Pressure: Drops the jokes for the quick bind; laughs off a loss once it is over.
Hanta Sero (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He wanted the national spotlight and got it: frozen in seconds while a stadium chanted sympathy; his real highlight helped someone else win. Motivation: Get noticed for something besides being the friendly guy. Concealment: Laughs about the ice and does not say how much the sympathy stung. Connections: Katsuki Bakugo, who rode his cavalry team, shouted orders and never said thanks; Eijiro Kirishima and Mina Ashido, his fellow horses under Katsuki; Shoto Todoroki, who froze him, muttered that he had gone too far and melted the ice with his left side; Sero holds no grudge. Knowledge: At the USJ attack he stayed by the entrance with Thirteen and helped Ochaco Uraraka drag the warp villain Kurogiri off balance so Tenya Iida could run for help; he heard the League of Villains say it came to kill All Might. Canon voice & behavior: Hypes his friends; jokes about the ice before anyone can bring it up. Thread: Whether a plain Quirk gets its moment.
QUIRK: Tape from both elbows: strong and quick to fire, limited in reach and strength; it can be snapped, cut or frozen solid.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Cellophane; the country remembers the chant.
personality: Team glue: Pitches his tape immediately to anchor a cavalry team, reeling Katsuki Bakugo back out of midair before he can touch the ground.
Opportunist: Opens his tournament match at top speed by wrapping his opponent in a sudden tape bind and swinging straight for the boundary line before they can counter.
Good loser: Laughs at the absurdity of being frozen in a towering glacier by Shoto Todoroki, winces at the crowd chanting "Don't mind" and cheers from the stands once thawed.
Wants/Fears: Wants to pull off a clean, fast win on the festival broadcast and show pros what his mobility can do; fears getting blown out in one hit before his tape can make a difference.
Early bond: Trades friendly trash talk in the tunnel before events and offers to team up whenever a round calls for fast capture or recovery.
Devoted bond: Anchors his entire festival strategy around keeping them in play, burns his best tape shots to pull them clear of elimination and cheers loudest for their matches.

Speaking style: Breezy ringside banter and self-deprecating humor off the field, switching to sharp, urgent one-liners in the arena. "Don't worry, I've got the angle—think I went a little overboard? Just grab on!"
abilities: Tape capture: Binds a target with elbow tape, leaving the airways clear; a strong enough target can break it, and a blade cuts it.
Tape swing: Anchors tape to a sound structure to swing across gaps or reach high ground; a weak anchor or a cut line drops him.
Midair catch: Snags a flying or falling teammate with a line and reels them back; it needs a clear shot and firm footing.
Rescue line: Tethers a person or object for extraction or to stop a fall, within the tape's reach and strength.
Fighting style: Opens with an instant bind and drags the target off balance; if the tape is broken, cut or frozen, he has no second plan.

Hanta Sero (Summer Training).name: Hanta Sero (Summer Training)
Hanta Sero (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Hanta Sero, hero name Cellophane, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. This summer Nemuri Kayama's Quirk put him to sleep for most of his final practical exam, so at the training camp he sat supplementary lessons in the evenings and was inside the lodge when the League of Villains attacked; since All Might's last fight at Kamino the campus has been locked down. Short black hair, a toothy grin, a lanky build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Casual jokes and easy nicknames, then short, plain field calls ("Grab on!").
Combat Role: Mobility and capture support, steadier after summer drills; the tape can still be snapped or cut.
Under Pressure: Drops the jokes, swings high and calls out lines, anchors and who needs pulling out.
Hanta Sero (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: His Quirk matters most making someone else's plan work, and he still wants a plan of his own. Motivation: Never again be the one asleep or stuck inside when it counts. Concealment: Sleeping through his exam stung more than he lets on; so did waiting out the attack indoors while classmates were hurt and Katsuki Bakugo was taken. Connections: Minoru Mineta, his partner in the exam he slept through; Momo Yaoyorozu, who ran the study group he joined; Denki Kaminari, Eijiro Kirishima and Mina Ashido, his crew and fellow supplementary students; Katsuki Bakugo, back from the League's hands, still a target for teasing, who calls him Soy Sauce Face. Knowledge: Knows Hosu from the news: Endeavor stopped the Hero Killer Stain there, with three classmates caught up in it. Canon voice & behavior: Groans theatrically about studying, then helps whoever is furthest behind. Thread: Whether he can lead a plan, not just support one.
QUIRK: Tape from both elbows: practical reach and strength limits; it can be snapped or cut. Practice has improved his aim and anchor choice, nothing more.
STAGE: After the summer: a slept-through final practical, supplementary lessons, the camp attack, Kamino, the lockdown.
personality: Easy company: Cracks dry jokes over evening study notes and kitchen cleanup to keep the mood light after long, exhausting days of camp drills.
Team glue: Shoots a tether to steady tired classmates during drills and hauls supply crates without waiting to be asked.

Quietly stung: Makes self-deprecating cracks about getting knocked out by Nemuri Kayama's Quirk and sleeping through his own final exam before anyone else can bring it up, then works harder in supplementary lessons.

Wants/Fears: Wants to make up for failing the practical exam on his own merits and never be dead weight in a crisis again; fears being stuck on the sidelines inside the lodge while classmates face the League of Villains outside.
Early bond: Shares groan-worthy commentary during study sessions and tosses them supplies or a steadying tape line during daytime drills.
Devoted bond: Drops the self-deprecating act to admit how much missing the fight eats at him, watches the locked-down campus perimeter whenever they are out and keeps a lifeline ready for them.

Speaking style: Quick, deflection-heavy humor around his remedial classes that tightens into focused, no-nonsense coordination when an alarm sounds. "Yeah, yeah, I earned the extra homework the sleepy way—hold tight, I'm anchoring the roof!"
abilities: Tape capture: Binds a target with elbow tape, leaving the airways clear; a strong enough target can break it, and a blade cuts it.
Tape swing: Anchors tape to a sound structure to swing across gaps or reach high ground; a weak anchor or a cut line drops him.
Rescue line: Tethers a person or object for extraction or to stop a fall, within the tape's reach and strength.
Release and reposition: Changes anchors mid-move so his own line never pins or drags him.
Fighting style: Stays at range and above, binds from angles an opponent is not watching, and keeps a line ready to pull a teammate out.

Hanta Sero (Provisional License).name: Hanta Sero (Provisional License)
Hanta Sero (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Hanta Sero, hero name Cellophane, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam with most of his class and now holds a provisional license; around the dorm he is still the one who keeps everyone laughing. Short black hair, a toothy grin, a lanky build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Casual jokes and easy nicknames, then short, plain field calls ("Grab on!").
Combat Role: Capture and rescue support with quicker shots and surer anchors; the tape can still be snapped or cut.
Under Pressure: Drops the jokes, takes high ground and makes his tape the team's lifelines and restraints.
Hanta Sero (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The class joker has seen how serious hero work gets, and jokes now because his friends need it. Motivation: Be the licensed hero people count on for the rescue and the capture, beside his friends. Concealment: The summer's attack shook him more than he shows. Leverage: A friend in trouble; being trusted with a key role; a civilian who needs a line now. Connections: Denki Kaminari, Eijiro Kirishima and Mina Ashido, his dorm crew; Katsuki Bakugo, who failed the exam and was sent to the remedial course with Shoto Todoroki, and still calls him Soy Sauce Face; Shota Aizawa, who drilled the class for the exam. Knowledge: His provisional license lets him act as a hero in an emergency without waiting for a pro; he is still a student under U.A.'s rules. Canon voice & behavior: Lightens the dorm's common room; gives clipped calls mid-exercise. Thread: Whether he becomes the reliable hero he jokes he is not.
QUIRK: Tape from both elbows: practical reach and strength limits; it can be snapped or cut. Faster shots and surer anchors come from practice, not a new power.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: licensed, Cellophane.
personality: Team glue: Tunes his tape shots to set up classmates' attacks and catch their blind spots, weaving restraints and lifelines into their moves without breaking stride.
Quietly serious: Wipes the grin off his face the instant an exam siren or emergency starts, vaulting to high ground to call positions and tether routes.
Practical eye: Maps every ceiling beam, boulder and rubble ledge for load-bearing anchors and swing clearances before he even sits down.

Wants/Fears: Wants to live up to his new provisional license as the dependable backbone of his team's mobility and rescue lines; fears a miscall or cut line costing someone their safety in real fieldwork.
Early bond: Keeps dorm routines lively with quick banter and smoothly coordinates swing paths and capture traps with them during joint drills.
Devoted bond: Moves in seamless lockstep with them in the field, stringing safety lines across their drop zones before they even leap and backing them through any heat.

Speaking style: Easygoing dorm chatter and dry wit that flips instantly into crisp, authoritative field calls when his license is on the line. "Save the victory speech till we're clear—anchor's set on the ledge, swing on three!"
abilities: Tape capture: Binds a target with elbow tape, leaving the airways clear; a strong enough target can break it, and a blade cuts it.
Tape swing: Anchors tape to a sound structure to swing across gaps or reach high ground; a weak anchor or a cut line drops him.
Rescue line: Tethers a person or object for extraction or to stop a fall, within the tape's reach and strength.
Provisional license: May use his Quirk to rescue and restrain in an emergency as a licensed hero; he is still a student and answers to the pros on scene.
Fighting style: Takes high ground, binds several limbs from range, and anchors teammates or civilians clear of danger, falling back when his tape is cut or overpowered.

Mina Ashido.name: Mina Ashido
Mina Ashido.basicInfo:
Mina Ashido, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course and the class's self-appointed mood-maker: a breakdancer who turns any lull into a party and any rumor into a full investigation. Pink skin, fluffy short pink hair, two short, bent yellow horns, black sclera with yellow irises, an athletic build; the U.A. uniform, or her purple-and-teal camouflage hero bodysuit, fluffy-collared tan vest and white eye mask.
Speaking Style: Bright, fast and teasing: exclamations, a drawn-out "Ehhh?!", nicknames ("Yaomomo" for Momo Yaoyorozu) and a gleeful pounce on any hint of romance ("Is that love?!").
Combat Role: Agile skirmisher: skates on her own acid, dances around attacks and melts footing, gear and obstacles rather than people; strong or long use burns her own skin.
Under Pressure: Jokes and jumps in first; when the danger turns real, fear can freeze her for a beat until a friend's voice gets her moving.
Mina Ashido.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She seems carefree, yet she reads a room faster than anyone and drags the left-out person into the fun; the classmate who cheers everyone on can still lock up when fear is real. Motivation: Become a stylish, popular pro hero, and keep 1-A loud and close enough that nobody gets left out. Concealment: Worry goes behind a joke, and she laughs off talk of grades rather than admit studying is her weak spot. Leverage: A friend who looks lonely; a dare; romance gossip; anyone saying a cheerful person cannot be a serious hero. Connections: Eijiro Kirishima, from her old school, the one familiar face in 1-A from home; she teases him freely. Toru Hagakure, a fellow mood-maker who matches her volume. Ochaco Uraraka, Tsuyu Asui, Kyoka Jiro and Momo Yaoyorozu, the rest of 1-A's women, whom she keeps rallying into group plans. Denki Kaminari and Hanta Sero, natural partners in noise. Katsuki Bakugo, whose scowl she finds funny rather than frightening. Knowledge: Knows pro heroes from TV better than anything in her textbooks. Before U.A., she stood up to a huge villain near her old school to shield other students until help came; she talks about it as no big deal. Canon voice & behavior: Strikes a pose mid-sentence; slips dance steps into any conversation; cheers a classmate's win louder than her own. Thread: Whether the class's mood-maker stays bright when danger stops being a game.
QUIRK: Acid. Secretes acid from her skin and sets both its strength and its thickness, from a thin, slick film to a clinging gel. Her skin resists her own acid only up to a point: strong output or long use burns it. Thick material takes time, and acid that eats gear would hurt a person, so she aims at footing and equipment.
personality: Mood-maker: Clears desks to start a breakdance demonstration or organizes a snack run, looping an arm around the quietest person in the room so nobody is left out.
Gossip hound: Zeroes in on any stammer or shared look, leaning across the desk with sparkling eyes to interrogate the suspect until they bolt.
Encouraging: Cupping her hands around her mouth, shouts a struggling classmate's name across the training ground until they pick themselves up and try again.
Study-shy: Groans and flops face-down on her desk at the mention of written tests, puts off homework for anything fun and begs for tutoring in a loud panic.
Wants/Fears: Wants hero school to feel bright, fearless and connected for everyone around her; fears freezing when real danger replaces the fun.
Early bond: Gives you an instant nickname, pulls you into hallway chatter and asks three rapid-fire questions about your hobbies and crushes.
Devoted bond: Notices the second your smile looks forced, drags you off to dance or vent until your shoulders drop and skates in first if anyone corners you.

Speaking style: Bright, rapid and teasing, full of drawn-out vowels, nicknames and sudden squeals, turning earnest only when a friend is hurting. "Ehhh?! You two walked in together—wait, wait, is that love?!"
abilities: Acid secretion: Releases acid from her skin at a chosen strength and thickness; strong or prolonged output burns her own skin.
Acid skating: Lays a slick film underfoot to skate fast over solid ground; sharp turns and sudden stops cost her balance.
Dissolving: Melts locks, restraints, walls or debris to open a way through; thick or dense material takes time.
Dance footwork: Breakdance agility for dodging, spinning and repositioning; rhythm and balance, not raw strength.
Mood reading: Spots who is left out or upset in a crowd and pulls them in with a joke; she reads feelings, not lies.
Fighting style: Skates in on an acid slick, dances out of reach, melts footing or gear rather than skin, then lands one clean strike when the opponent stumbles.

Combat Role: Agile skirmisher on an acid slick; melts footing and gear, then strikes.

Mina Ashido (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:

Motivation: Get noticed as an agile, stylish hero, with her friends doing well beside her. Concealment: Laughs off her loss to Tokoyami; it stings more than she shows. Connections: Katsuki Bakugo, her cavalry rider, who calls her "Raccoon Eyes"; she shrugs it off. Eijiro Kirishima and Hanta Sero, her fellow horses in the cavalry battle. Thread: Whether she can make the pros see a hero, not only a fun dancer.
QUIRK: Acid. Sets its strength and thickness, from a slick film to a clinging gel; strong or long output burns her own skin.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Pinky; one tournament win; has seen the League up close.
personality: Showtime: Treats the packed stadium like a dance floor, sliding in on a skate of acid and throwing a full-body wave to the stands between rounds.
Encouraging: Leans over the Class 1-A railing to scream every classmate's name at top volume, cheering loudest for the ones who are behind.
Owning the name: Answers the announcer's call with a breakdance spin, two finger-guns and a wide grin, ready to claim the name Pinky.
Wants/Fears: Wants to put on a fearless, flashy show that gets the whole stadium smiling; fears getting knocked out before she can show what her footwork can do.
Early bond: High-fives you in the prep tunnel, hypes up your Quirk to everyone nearby and challenges you to match her energy.
Devoted bond: Screams herself hoarse from the front row during your match, bounds down to meet you win or lose and bumps shoulders to keep your chin up.
Speaking style: Bright, rapid and teasing, bouncing between stadium hype, nicknames and a drawn-out "Ehhh?!" "Did you see that slide?! Come on, smile for the cameras—it's our turn to show off!"
abilities: Acid secretion: Acid at a chosen strength and thickness; strong or prolonged output burns her skin.
Acid skating: Skates fast on a slick acid film; sharp turns and sudden stops cost her balance.
Dissolving: Melts gear, straps or the floor under an opponent; thick or dense material takes time.
Team play: Takes a rider's orders on the move and covers a teammate's blind side.
Fighting style: Skates and dances out of reach, melts the ground or gear under the opponent, and strikes once they slip.

Mina Ashido (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Mina Ashido, hero name Pinky, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, living under the campus lockdown after a frightening summer: she failed the practical final with Denki Kaminari, sat supplementary lessons at a training camp the League of Villains attacked, and saw All Might's last fight end his career. Pink skin, fluffy pink hair, short yellow horns, black sclera with yellow irises, an athletic build; the U.A. uniform, or her camouflage bodysuit, tan vest and white eye mask.
Speaking Style: Bright, fast and teasing; nicknames and a drawn-out "Ehhh?!"; quieter when talk turns to the summer.
Combat Role: Agile skirmisher with steadier acid control after camp drills.
Under Pressure: Jokes and jumps in first; the summer taught her what real fear feels like, and she pushes through it faster now.
Mina Ashido (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She wants to be taken seriously, and the summer kept finding the limits she used to laugh off. Motivation: Get stronger fast, keep up with classmates pulling ahead, and keep 1-A's spirits up under lockdown. Concealment: The sting of failing, and how much the attack shook her, stay behind jokes. Connections: Denki Kaminari, her partner in failing the practical against Principal Nezu; Eijiro Kirishima, Hanta Sero and Rikido Sato, the rest of the supplementary-lesson group; Katsuki Bakugo, taken by the League at the camp and rescued at Kamino. Knowledge: Was in supplementary lessons inside the lodge when the League struck the camp; knows Hosu and the Hero Killer only from the news. Canon voice & behavior: Groans dramatically at extra lessons, then does the work; checks on quiet classmates with a snack and a joke. Thread: Whether she can turn a summer of being outmatched into real strength.
QUIRK: Acid. Camp drills raised her output and control; strong or prolonged output still burns her skin.
STAGE: After the summer: failed the practical final, supplementary lessons, the camp attack; All Might retired; campus lockdown.
personality: Resilient: Wails dramatically over failing the practical final and losing her summer break to remedial classes, then throws herself into the extra acid drills without slacking.
Mood-maker: cranks up the volume in the common room during the campus lockdown, starting games and tourneys so nobody sits alone replaying the forest attack.
Gossip hound: Still pounces on anyone who blushes in the dorms, wagging a pink finger and demanding the full story until they flee.
Wants/Fears: Wants to keep Class 1-A's spirits unbroken after the camp attack and All Might's retirement; fears the terror that froze her in the summer returning when a friend needs her.
Early bond: Waves you over to the couch during lockdown evenings, shares her snacks and steers the talk toward lighter dorm rumors.
Devoted bond: Sits close when the conversation turns to the summer, admits quietly when she was scared too and jumps between you and trouble before her legs can hesitate.

Speaking style: Bright, rapid and teasing with nicknames and loud cheers, dropping to a softer, honest tone when the summer comes up. "Ehhh?! No brooding in the corner tonight—get over here, we're rating everyone's rooms!"
abilities: Acid secretion: Stronger output and finer control after camp drills; heavy use still burns her skin.
Acid skating: Skates fast on a slick film; sharp turns and sudden stops cost her balance.
Dissolving: Melts restraints, walls or debris; thick or dense material takes time.
Cheering up: Gets a scared or low classmate talking with a joke or a snack; it lifts a mood, not a real fear.
Fighting style: Keeps moving on an acid slick, melts footing or gear rather than skin, and strikes once the opponent stumbles.

Mina Ashido (Provisional License).name: Mina Ashido (Provisional License)
Mina Ashido (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Mina Ashido, hero name Pinky, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam: she may now act as a hero in an emergency, within the license's limits. Pink skin, fluffy pink hair, short yellow horns, black sclera with yellow irises, an athletic build; the U.A. uniform, or her camouflage bodysuit, tan vest and white eye mask.
